definition_zh: 总的；毛的；严重的；粗俗的
definition_en: total before deductions, very serious, or rude and unpleasant
core_image: 账本最后一页写着未扣除的总数
scene: 公司公布年度总收入。The company reported its gross income for the year.
sceneCN: 这里 gross 是「总的、毛的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：公司公布年度总收入。

senses.title: Total before deductions
senses.definition: total, before costs or tax are taken away
senses.definitionCN: 扣除成本或税款之前的总数
senses.example: The company reported its gross income for the year.
senses.exampleCN: 公司公布年度总收入。
senses.why: This is the main business sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的商业义项。

senses.title: Very serious
senses.definition: very bad or serious, as of a mistake
senses.definitionCN: 指错误等极其严重、恶劣
senses.example: It was gross negligence.
senses.exampleCN: 那是严重的疏忽。
senses.why: The sense of coarse grew into extreme badness.
senses.whyCN: 「粗劣」义发展为「极其糟糕」。

senses.title: Rude and unpleasant
senses.definition: rude, dirty, or disgusting
senses.definitionCN: 粗鲁、污秽或令人恶心的
senses.example: That joke was gross.
senses.exampleCN: 那个笑话太低俗了。
senses.why: The oldest sense was coarse or thick.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「粗糙、粗厚」。

intro.en: Gross comes from Latin grossus, thick or coarse, through Old French gros.
intro.cn: gross 经古法语 gros 来自拉丁语 grossus，意为粗厚的、粗糙的。

items.en: Grossus meant thick or coarse.
items.cn: grossus 意为粗厚的、粗糙的。

items.en: Gros meant big, thick, or coarse.
items.cn: gros 意为大的、厚的、粗的。

items.en: Gross meant large or coarse.
items.cn: gross 意为大的或粗的。

items.en: The trade sense meant total before deductions.
items.cn: 商业义指未扣除前的总额。

items.en: The rude sense strengthened in speech.
items.cn: 口语中「粗俗」义逐渐加强。

note.en: Gross is compared with look-alike words and words for total or rude.
note.cn: 把 gross 与形近词以及表示总额或粗俗的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Gross began as thick or coarse and now means total, serious, or disgusting.
normalIntro.cn: gross 原为「粗厚」，如今指总额、严重或令人恶心。

normal.en: What is the gross income?
The box weighs ten kilos gross.
That was gross negligence.
The smell was gross.
He was grossly unfair.

abstract.en: A total hides the costs inside it.
abstract.cn: 总额里藏着尚未扣除的成本。

abstract.en: Coarse manners and coarse cloth share a word.
abstract.cn: 粗鲁的举止与粗糙的布，共用一个词。

abstract.en: What is thick can also be too much.
abstract.cn: 厚重到极点，也会变成过分。

examples.en: The company reported its gross income for the year.
It was gross negligence.
That joke was gross.

dict_mnemonic.text: gross 是「总的、毛的」，也指「严重的、粗俗的」；gross income 是总收入，gross weight 是毛重，gross negligence 是严重疏忽。

root: 经古法语 gros 来自拉丁语 grossus（粗厚的、粗糙的）；由「粗大」发展出「总额」的商业义，也保留「粗俗、严重」的评价义。

sensesIntro.en: Gross means total before deductions, very serious, or rude and disgusting.
sensesIntro.cn: gross 指未扣除前的总额、极其严重，或粗俗恶心。

core.en: Something thick and large, taken as a whole.
core.cn: 粗厚而庞大，被整体看待的东西。

branches.en: A ledger shows one large sum.
branches.cn: 账本上写着一个大总额。

branches.en: A broken rail marks a bad mistake.
branches.cn: 断裂的栏杆标示出严重错误。

branches.en: A rude joke empties the room.
branches.cn: 一个粗俗的笑话让满屋人散去。

branches.en: A big total can hide a big fault.
branches.cn: 巨大的总额，可能掩盖巨大的过失。

branches.en: Coarse speech and coarse errors both offend.
branches.cn: 粗俗的言语与严重的错误，都令人不适。

intro.en: Gross forms comparisons and two common adverbs and nouns.
intro.cn: gross 构成比较级以及常用的副词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is grossus, thick or coarse.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁语源头是 grossus，意为粗厚的、粗糙的。

items.example: That joke was grosser than the first.
items.exampleCN: 那个笑话比第一个更粗俗。

items.example: It was the grossest remark of the night.
The grossness of the act shocked us.
items.exampleCN: 这一行为的恶劣让我们震惊。

items.example: The gross weight is ten kilos.

definition_zh: 地下水；储存在土壤孔隙与岩石裂隙中的水
definition_en: water held in the pores and cracks of soil and rock beneath the earth's surface
core_image: 剖开的地层像海绵，缝隙里积满水，水位面在土层中划出一条平线
scene: 干旱季节，村里的井仍能提出清水，因为水藏在地下的砂砾缝隙里。Even in the dry season the village well still yields clear groundwater from the sandy layers below.
sceneCN: 这里 groundwater 指「储存于地表以下土壤与岩石孔隙中的水」（第 1 个义项：位于饱和带、可被井取出的地下水体）；句意为即使在旱季，村里的井仍能从下面的砂层中取出清澈的地下水。可辨识物件：井口、绳索、水桶、砂砾层、含水缝。

pos.zh: 地下水（不可数，指地下饱和带中的水）

forms.label: 复数（指多个含水系统，罕用）

derivatives.zh: 地下水体（复数，指多个系统）

senses.title: Water below the surface
senses.definition: water stored in the saturated zone of soil and rock beneath the land surface
senses.definitionCN: 储存于陆面以下土壤与岩石饱和带中的水
senses.example: Half the village drinks groundwater from a single well.
senses.exampleCN: 村里一半人喝的是同一口井的地下水。
senses.why: Rain that sinks instead of running off does not disappear; it fills the empty spaces in soil and rock and stays there, out of sight.
senses.whyCN: 没有流走而渗下去的雨并没有消失；它填满土壤与岩石中的空隙并留在那里，只是看不见。

senses.title: Below the water table
senses.definition: the water in the zone where every pore is already full, above the water table
senses.definitionCN: 潜水面以下、所有孔隙都已被水充满的带中的水
senses.example: Above the water table the soil is damp; below it, every pore is full of groundwater.
senses.exampleCN: 潜水面以上的土壤是湿的；在它以下，每个孔隙都充满地下水。
senses.why: The defining line is saturation: above it pores hold air as well as water, below it there is no room left for air.
senses.whyCN: 决定性的界线是饱和：界线以上孔隙里还有空气，界线以下则不再有空气的位置。

senses.title: A source of supply
senses.definition: water drawn from wells and springs for drinking, farming and industry
senses.definitionCN: 从井与泉中取出、用于饮用、农业与工业的水
senses.example: The city's supply comes from groundwater pumped two hundred metres down.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的供水来自两百米深处抽出的地下水。
senses.why: Because it is stored and shielded from evaporation, groundwater is the most reliable source in regions with a long dry season.
senses.whyCN: 由于被储存起来且不受蒸发影响，地下水是旱季漫长地区最可靠的来源。

senses.title: The counterpart of surface water
senses.definition: the water category opposed to rivers, lakes and reservoirs in law and management
senses.definitionCN: 在法律与管理中与河流、湖泊、水库相对的水类
senses.example: The permit separates rights over surface water from rights over groundwater.
senses.exampleCN: 这份许可把地表水权与地下水权分开。
senses.why: The two categories behave differently: surface water responds to rain within hours, groundwater within months or years.
senses.whyCN: 两类水的行为不同：地表水在几小时内响应降雨，地下水则要数月或数年。

senses.title: Water inside an aquifer
senses.definition: the water held and transmitted by a permeable rock unit
senses.definitionCN: 由可渗透岩层储存并传输的水
senses.example: The sandstone aquifer holds groundwater that is thousands of years old.
senses.exampleCN: 砂岩含水层中的地下水已有数千年之久。
senses.why: An aquifer is the container; groundwater is the contents. The same water is named for the rock only when the rock can hold and move it.
senses.whyCN: 含水层是容器，地下水是内容物；只有当岩层能储存并输送水时，其中的水才以这种岩层来命名。

senses.title: Overdraft and pollution
senses.titleCN: 超采与污染：被透支的水
senses.definition: the water resource that can be depleted or contaminated by human use
senses.definitionCN: 会因人类使用而枯竭或被污染的水资源
senses.example: Decades of pumping have left the groundwater salty and depleted.
senses.exampleCN: 数十年的抽水使地下水变得含盐且枯竭。
senses.why: Because the store refills slowly, taking water faster than recharge is like spending capital instead of interest.
senses.whyCN: 由于储库补充很慢，取水快于补给就像花本金而不是花利息。

senses.title: The hidden base flow
senses.definition: the water that seeps into streams between storms and keeps them flowing in dry weather
senses.definitionCN: 在两次暴雨之间渗入溪流、使溪流在旱天仍不断流的水
senses.example: Even without rain, the stream survives on groundwater.
senses.exampleCN: 即使不下雨，这条溪流也靠地下水维持。
senses.why: A river in dry weather is mostly an exposed edge of the water table, so the invisible store is what keeps the visible channel alive.
senses.whyCN: 旱天的河流很大程度上是潜水面露出的边缘，因此看不见的储库才是让看得见的水道活着的原因。

senses.title: Abstract: a hidden reserve
senses.definition: any resource kept out of sight that can be drawn on later
senses.definitionCN: 任何藏而不露、日后可取用的资源
senses.example: The company has groundwater of goodwill to draw on in hard times.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司在困难时期有可以动用的善意储备。
senses.why: The image transfers easily: something valuable, invisible, slowly renewed, and easy to overdraw.
senses.whyCN: 这个意象很容易迁移：有价值、看不见、补充缓慢，而且容易被透支。

intro.en: Groundwater is an English compound of two native Old English words. The closed spelling is recent, and the geological sense grew out of the older meaning of ground as the earth's surface. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: groundwater 是两个古英语本族词构成的英语复合词。连写形式出现较晚，其地质学含义由 ground「地表」的旧义发展而来。年代为约数。

items.en: Grund meant the bottom, foundation or surface of the earth; its deeper origin is uncertain, and no single Indo-European root is agreed for it.
items.cn: grund 指底部、地基或地面；其更早来源不确定，学界未就单一印欧词根达成一致。

items.en: Wæter continues Proto-Germanic *watōr and belongs to the same Indo-European family as Greek hydōr and Latin unda, the last link being less certain.
items.cn: wæter 延续原始日耳曼语 *watōr，与希腊语 hydōr、拉丁语 unda 同属一个印欧词族，其中与 unda 的联系较不确定。

items.en: Geologists wrote the two words separately as ground water while describing wells, springs and the layers that supply them.
items.cn: 地质学者在描述井、泉与供水岩层时，把这两个词分写为 ground water。

items.en: The single-word spelling groundwater spread in the twentieth century, when the resource became a subject of its own in engineering and law.
items.cn: 二十世纪，当这一资源成为工程与法律的独立对象时，连写形式 groundwater 流行开来。

items.en: Source uncertain (deep etymology and first attestation): the origin of grund before Old English is unsettled, and dictionaries do not fix the first use of the closed spelling.
items.cn: 来源不确定（深层词源与首见年代）：grund 在古英语之前的来源尚无定论，辞书也未确定连写形式的首次使用。

note.en: The first group holds look-alike and spelling variants; the second holds the water terms it is most often confused with.
note.cn: 第一组是形近词与拼写变体；第二组是最容易与之混淆的水类术语。

entries.definition: The older two-word spelling of the same term, still seen in older geological texts.
entries.definitionCN: 同一术语较早的分写形式，仍见于较早的地质文献。

entries.definition: Below the surface as a position or direction; it does not name water.
entries.definitionCN: 表示地表以下的位置或方向，并不指水本身。

entries.definition: The solid surface of the earth; only the compound names the water inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 地球的固体表面；只有复合词才指其中的水。

entries.definition: The rock or sediment that holds and transmits groundwater; the water is its contents.
entries.definitionCN: 储存并输送地下水的岩层或沉积物；地下水是其中的内容物。

entries.definition: Water in the unsaturated layer, held by soil particles and available to roots.
entries.definitionCN: 非饱和层中的水，被土粒吸附并可被根系利用。

entries.definition: Water in rivers, lakes and reservoirs, exposed to the air and quick to respond to rain.
entries.definitionCN: 河流、湖泊与水库中的水，暴露于空气并对降雨响应迅速。

entries.definition: A place where groundwater reaches the surface on its own, not a store of water.
entries.definitionCN: 地下水自行到达地表之处，而非水的储库。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the two native words, the saturation line, and the two categories water managers actually use.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个本族词、饱和界线，以及水资源管理者真正使用的两个类别。

normal.en: ground + water is literally 'the water of the ground', so the compound needs no memorising.
normal.cn: ground 加 water 字面就是「地面的水」，这个复合词不需要另记。

normal.en: The water table is the top surface of the groundwater, like the surface of a hidden lake.
normal.cn: 潜水面就是地下水的顶面，像一座看不见的湖的水面。

normal.en: Recharge is income, discharge is spending, and overdraft is pumping faster than recharge.
normal.cn: 补给是收入，排泄是支出，超采就是抽水快于补给。

normal.en: Groundwater is to an aquifer what milk is to a bottle: contents and container.
normal.cn: 地下水与含水层的关系，就像牛奶与瓶子的关系：内容物与容器。

normal.en: In dry weather a stream is fed by groundwater, which is why it keeps flowing without rain.
normal.cn: 旱天溪流由地下水补给，所以不下雨也不断流。

abstract.en: Abstractly, groundwater is stored time: water that fell long ago and has not yet left.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，地下水是被储存的时间：很久以前落下、至今尚未离开的水。

abstract.en: It is capital rather than income, so spending it feels free until the account is empty.
abstract.cn: 它是本金而不是利息，因此花用它在账空之前感觉像是免费的。

abstract.en: Anything valuable, unseen and slowly renewed follows the same pattern — including trust and reputation.
abstract.cn: 任何有价值、看不见、补充缓慢的东西都遵循同一模式——包括信任与声誉。

examples.en: Groundwater provides about half of the world's drinking water.
examples.cn: 地下水提供了全世界约一半的饮用水。

examples.en: Nitrates from farms can reach groundwater and stay there for years.
examples.cn: 农场的硝酸盐会进入地下水并在那里留存多年。

examples.en: Where groundwater is mined faster than it refills, the land itself begins to sink.
examples.cn: 在地下水开采快于补给的地方，土地本身会开始下沉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「地（ground）+ 水（water）」——藏在地面下缝隙里的水 → 地下水

root: 古英语 grund「地面、底部」+ wæter「水」，英语本族复合词，十九世纪起用于地质学。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses go downward and then back out: water below the surface, the saturated store, its use as supply, its contrast with surface water, its container, its depletion, its hidden return to rivers, and finally the metaphor of a reserve.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项先向下再向外：地表以下的水、饱和储库、作为水源的用途、与地表水的对照、它的容器、它的枯竭、它暗中回到河流，最后是「储备」的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cutaway of soil and rock, pores full of water, a flat water line across the section.
core.cn: 核心意象：土壤与岩石的剖面，孔隙充满水，一条平直的水位线横贯其间。

branches.en: FROM DRY TO FULL: the same water is named at the surface and again below the saturation line.
branches.cn: 从干到满：同一批水在地表被命名一次，在饱和线以下又被命名一次。

branches.en: TWO CATEGORIES OF SUPPLY: what is pumped from below is managed against what flows above.
branches.cn: 两类供水：从地下抽取的水与从地表流过的水被分开管理。

branches.en: CONTENTS AND CONTAINER: the aquifer holds the water, and the water takes the aquifer's name.
branches.cn: 内容与容器：含水层储存水，水也随含水层得名。

branches.en: OVERDRAFT: a slow-filling store can be spent faster than it refills.
branches.cn: 透支：补充缓慢的储库可以被花得比补充更快。

branches.en: HIDDEN RETURN AND HIDDEN RESERVE: the unseen store feeds rivers, and the same image serves for any reserve.
branches.cn: 隐性的回归与隐性的储备：看不见的储库供养河流，同一意象也可用于任何储备。

intro.en: Groundwater is a transparent native compound, so its affix work is mostly compounding and adjective formation rather than prefixation.
intro.cn: groundwater 是透明的本族复合词，因此它的构词工作主要是复合与形容词化，而非加前缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root here; both members are native Old English. The Latin-based vocabulary of the topic enters through borrowings such as aquifer, which is treated separately.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根；两个成分都是古英语本族词。这一主题的拉丁语词汇通过 aquifer 一类借词进入，另作处理。

items.structure: ground (Old English grund, bottom or surface of the earth)
items.meaning: the solid surface; the lower part

items.example: Groundwater is cleaner than the river here.
items.exampleCN: 这里的地下水比河水干净。

items.example: A groundwater-fed wetland stayed green all summer.
items.exampleCN: 一片由地下水补给的湿地整个夏天都保持绿色。

items.meaningCN: 依靠地下水才能存续的
items.example: Groundwater-dependent plants wither when the table drops.
items.exampleCN: 依赖地下水的植物在水位下降时枯萎。

items.structure: water + table (English compound of two native words)
items.meaning: the upper surface of the saturated zone
items.example: The water table fell by two metres.

items.structure: re- (again) + charge (to load, from Latin carricare)
items.meaning: the refilling of a groundwater store
items.exampleCN: 冬季降雨提供大部分补给。

items.meaning: water leaving the ground or a channel
items.exampleCN: 这眼泉的排出量从未停止。

definition_en: the process of becoming larger, an increase, or an abnormal lump in the body
core_image: 小树苗一年年长高成树
scene: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
sceneCN: 这里 growth 是「生长」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小树苗的生长需要阳光。

senses.title: Biological growth
senses.definition: the process by which a living thing becomes larger
senses.definitionCN: 生物变大的过程
senses.example: The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
senses.exampleCN: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。
senses.why: This is the basic living sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的生命义项。

senses.title: Increase
senses.definition: an increase in size, number, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 规模、数量或金额的增加
senses.example: Economic growth slowed last year.
senses.exampleCN: 去年经济增长放缓。
senses.why: The living sense spread to numbers and trade.
senses.whyCN: 生命义扩展到数字与贸易。

senses.title: Abnormal lump
senses.definition: an unusual lump growing in or on the body
senses.definitionCN: 身体内外异常长出的肿块
senses.example: The doctor removed a small growth.
senses.exampleCN: 医生切除了一个小肿块。
senses.why: A growth is simply something that grows.
senses.whyCN: growth 字面上就是「长出来的东西」。

intro.en: Growth is grow plus the Old English noun ending -th, as in warmth and length.
intro.cn: growth 由 grow 加古英语名词后缀 -th 构成，类似 warmth 与 length。

items.en: The root meant to grow or increase.
items.cn: 该词根意为生长、增加。

items.en: Growan meant to grow.
items.cn: growan 意为生长。

items.en: The ending -th formed nouns of state.
items.cn: 后缀 -th 构成表示状态的名词。

items.en: Growthe named the process of growing.
items.cn: growthe 指生长的过程。

items.en: The sense widened to economic increase.
items.cn: 词义扩展到经济增长。

note.en: Growth is compared with look-alike words and words for increase.
note.cn: 把 growth 与形近词以及表示增长的词作比较。

entries.definition: a set of people or things

normalIntro.en: Growth is the noun of grow: a tree's rising, an economy's increase, or a lump.
normalIntro.cn: growth 是 grow 的名词：树的生长、经济的增长，或一个肿块。

normal.en: Plant growth is slow in winter.
The growth rate is rising.
They support personal growth.
Population growth puts pressure on cities.
normal.cn: 人口增长给城市带来压力。

normal.en: The scan showed a small growth.
normal.cn: 扫描显示有一个小肿块。

abstract.en: Every increase leaves a record of time.
abstract.cn: 每一次增长，都留下时间的记录。

abstract.en: What grows unseen still changes the shape.
abstract.cn: 看不见的生长，也在改变形状。

abstract.en: Growth asks for room before it asks for thanks.
abstract.cn: 成长先要空间，再谈感谢。

examples.en: The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
examples.cn: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。

examples.en: Economic growth slowed last year.
The doctor removed a small growth.
examples.cn: 医生切除了一个小肿块。

dict_mnemonic.text: growth 是 grow 的名词形式，指「生长、增长、发展」，医学上也指「赘生物」；economic growth 是经济增长，growth rate 是增长率。

root: 由 grow 加古英语名词后缀 -th 构成，表示「生长的过程或状态」；由生物生长扩展到数量、经济的增长，也指身体上的赘生物。

sensesIntro.en: Growth means biological growing, an increase in amount, or an abnormal lump.
sensesIntro.cn: growth 指生物生长、数量增长，或异常肿块。

core.en: The process of getting larger.
core.cn: 逐渐变大的过程。

branches.en: A young tree widens its trunk.
branches.cn: 小树加粗了自己的树干。

branches.en: A graph line climbs each quarter.
branches.cn: 曲线图每一季都在上升。

branches.en: A small lump appears under the skin.
branches.cn: 皮下出现一个小肿块。

branches.en: Living things and markets both rise.
branches.cn: 生物与市场，都在「长」。

branches.en: Increase is not always healthy.
branches.cn: 增长并不总是健康的。

intro.en: Growth forms plurals and links back to the verb grow.
intro.cn: growth 构成复数，并与动词 grow 相连。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 过度生长的植物遮住了小路。

definition_en: a firm promise that something will be done, or a promise to repair or replace goods
core_image: 店家在收据上写下一年保修的承诺
scene: 店家保证一年内免费维修。The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
sceneCN: 这里 guarantee 是「保证」（第 1 个义项）；句意：店家保证一年内免费维修。

senses.title: Firm promise
senses.definition: a formal promise that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 对某事必定发生的正式承诺
senses.example: The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 店家保证一年内免费维修。
senses.why: This is the general modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最通用的义项。

senses.title: Product warranty
senses.definition: a written promise to repair or replace a product
senses.definitionCN: 对产品修理或更换的书面承诺
senses.example: The phone is still under guarantee.
senses.exampleCN: 这部手机还在保修期内。
senses.why: Shops turned the promise into a document.
senses.whyCN: 商家把承诺变成了一纸凭证。

senses.title: Legal surety
senses.definition: a promise to pay another person's debt if they fail
senses.definitionCN: 在他人无法偿还时替其付款的承诺
senses.example: His uncle guaranteed the loan.
senses.exampleCN: 他的叔叔为这笔贷款作了担保。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a pledge for another.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是为他人作保。

intro.en: Guarantee comes from Old French garantie, a pledge of protection, from garantir, to protect.
intro.cn: guarantee 来自古法语 garantie（保护性担保），源头是 garantir（保护）。

items.en: The root meant to protect or guard.
items.cn: 该词根意为保护、看守。

items.en: Garant meant a person who protects.
items.cn: garant 指提供保护的人。

items.en: Garantie meant a pledge.
items.cn: garantie 意为担保、保证。

items.en: Guarantee meant a promise of safety.
items.cn: guarantee 意为安全的承诺。

items.en: The word also named a product warranty.
items.cn: 这个词也指产品保修。

note.en: Guarantee is compared with look-alike words and words for promises.
note.cn: 把 guarantee 与形近词以及表示承诺的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who protects a place
a statement that you will do something

normalIntro.en: Guarantee began as protection and now means a firm promise or a warranty.
normalIntro.cn: guarantee 原指保护，如今指坚定的承诺或保修凭证。

normal.en: We guarantee delivery by Friday.
The watch has a two-year guarantee.
Hard work does not guarantee success.
Is the laptop still under guarantee?
normal.cn: 这台笔记本电脑还在保修期内吗？

normal.en: His father guaranteed the loan.
normal.cn: 他父亲为这笔贷款作了担保。

abstract.en: A promise is a wall built in advance.
abstract.cn: 承诺，是提前筑起的一道墙。

abstract.en: A warranty is trust written down.
abstract.cn: 保修，是把信任写成了文字。

abstract.en: No one can guarantee the weather.
abstract.cn: 没有人能保证天气。

examples.en: The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
examples.cn: 店家保证一年内免费维修。

examples.en: The phone is still under guarantee.
examples.cn: 这部手机还在保修期内。

examples.en: His uncle guaranteed the loan.
examples.cn: 他的叔叔为这笔贷款作了担保。

dict_mnemonic.text: guarantee 是「保证、保修、担保」；under guarantee 是在保修期内，money-back guarantee 是退款保证；动词过去式加 d 变 guaranteed。

root: 来自古法语 garantie（担保），源头是 garantir（保护），更早与日耳曼语「看守、保护」有关；由「为人作保」扩展为一般承诺与产品保修。

sensesIntro.en: Guarantee means a firm promise, a product warranty, or legal surety for another.
sensesIntro.cn: guarantee 指坚定的承诺、产品保修，或为他人作法律担保。

core.en: A promise that stands behind something.
core.cn: 为某事撑腰的承诺。

branches.en: A seller gives a firm word.
branches.cn: 卖家给出坚定的承诺。

branches.en: A dated card sits in the box.
branches.cn: 盒子里放着一张注明日期的保修卡。

branches.en: A relative signs for a loan.
branches.cn: 一位亲属为贷款签字作保。

branches.en: The spoken promise becomes a paper right.
branches.cn: 口头的承诺变成纸上的权利。

branches.en: Goods and debts both need a backer.
branches.cn: 商品与债务，都需要有人兜底。

intro.en: Guarantee forms verb parts, an adjective, and legal nouns.
intro.cn: guarantee 构成动词变化、形容词和法律名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word came through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，经古法语传入。

definition_en: to say something without being sure, or to think something is likely
core_image: 一个人闭着眼从几个答案里挑一个
scene: 我猜他要迟到。I guess he will be late.
sceneCN: 这里 guess 是「以为、猜测」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我猜他要迟到。

senses.title: Say without certainty
senses.definition: to give an answer without being sure it is right
senses.definitionCN: 在不确定是否正确时给出答案
senses.example: I guess he will be late.
senses.exampleCN: 我猜他要迟到。
senses.why: This is the core sense of uncertain judgment.
senses.whyCN: 这是不确定判断的核心义项。

senses.title: Think likely
senses.definition: to think that something is probably true
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事很可能是真的
senses.example: I guess you are right.
senses.exampleCN: 我想你是对的。
senses.why: In speech guess often means simply suppose.
senses.whyCN: 口语中 guess 常只表示「认为」。

senses.title: An attempt to guess
senses.definition: an opinion formed without enough information
senses.definitionCN: 信息不足时形成的看法
senses.example: Her guess turned out to be right.
senses.exampleCN: 她的猜测结果是对的。
senses.why: The noun names the act or result.
senses.whyCN: 名词义指猜测的行为或结果。

intro.en: Guess comes from Middle English gessen, probably from a Scandinavian source.
intro.cn: guess 来自中古英语 gessen，可能源自斯堪的纳维亚语。

items.en: The exact earlier source is not certain.
items.cn: 更早的确切来源并不确定。

items.en: A related form meant to think or believe.
items.cn: 相关词形意为思考、认为。

items.en: Gessen meant to form an opinion.
items.cn: gessen 意为形成看法。

items.en: Guess kept the sense of judging without proof.
items.cn: guess 保留了无证据判断的含义。

items.en: The casual sense of suppose became common.
items.cn: 口语中「认为、料想」的用法变得常见。

note.en: Guess is compared with look-alike words and words for estimating.
note.cn: 把 guess 与形近词以及表示估计的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who shows the way
to form a picture in the mind

normalIntro.en: Guess is judgment without proof, and in speech it often just means suppose.
normalIntro.cn: guess 是没有证据的判断，口语里常常只是「认为」。

normal.en: Guess my age.
You guessed right.
I guess it will rain.
Have a guess at the price.
His guess was close.

abstract.en: A guess is a bridge over missing facts.
abstract.cn: 猜测，是跨过缺失事实的桥。

abstract.en: The mind fills gaps before the facts arrive.
abstract.cn: 事实未到，头脑先填补空白。

abstract.en: Every guess risks being wrong.
abstract.cn: 每个猜测，都有猜错的风险。

examples.en: I guess he will be late.
I guess you are right.
Her guess turned out to be right.

dict_mnemonic.text: guess 是「猜测、以为」；guess right 是猜对，have a guess 是猜一猜，guess what 是你猜怎么着；第三人称单数加 es 变 guesses。

root: 来自中古英语 gessen，可能源自斯堪的纳维亚语；核心是信息不足时形成判断，口语中弱化为「认为、料想」。

sensesIntro.en: Guess means to answer without certainty, to suppose, or the opinion so formed.
sensesIntro.cn: guess 指不确定地作答、认为，或由此形成的猜测。

core.en: Filling a gap in knowledge with a likely answer.
core.cn: 用一个可能的答案填补知识的空白。

branches.en: A hand covers a hidden card.
branches.cn: 一只手盖住暗牌。

branches.en: A friend nods at a simple remark.
branches.cn: 朋友对一句简单的话点头。

branches.en: A note records a rough answer.
branches.cn: 便签上记着一个粗略答案。

branches.en: Uncertain judgment softens into belief.
branches.cn: 不确定的判断，会软化成相信。

branches.en: The act and its result share one name.
branches.cn: 猜测的动作与结果，共用一个名字。

intro.en: Guess forms verb parts and a few nouns.
intro.cn: guess 构成动词变化和若干名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is of uncertain Germanic origin.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，其日耳曼语来源不确定。

definition_en: help and advice about what to do, or the system that steers a moving object
core_image: 老师俯身指着学生的作业耐心讲解
scene: 老师给了她耐心的指导。The teacher gave her patient guidance.
sceneCN: 这里 guidance 是「指导」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师给了她耐心的指导。

senses.title: Help and advice
senses.definition: help and advice given to someone who needs it
senses.definitionCN: 给予需要者的帮助和建议
senses.example: The teacher gave her patient guidance.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给了她耐心的指导。
senses.why: This is the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常最常用的义项。

senses.title: Steering a vehicle
senses.definition: the system that controls the path of a missile or vehicle
senses.definitionCN: 控制导弹或交通工具飞行路线的系统
senses.example: The rocket uses a new guidance system.
senses.exampleCN: 火箭使用新的制导系统。
senses.why: Guiding a person and guiding a machine are one idea.
senses.whyCN: 引导人与引导机器是同一个概念。

senses.title: Official advice
senses.definition: official advice on study or work choices
senses.definitionCN: 关于学业或职业选择的正式建议
senses.example: The school offers career guidance.
senses.exampleCN: 学校提供职业辅导。
senses.why: Institutions turned advice into a service.
senses.whyCN: 机构把建议变成了一项服务。

intro.en: Guidance is guide plus the noun ending -ance, from Old French guider, to lead.
intro.cn: guidance 由 guide 加名词后缀 -ance 构成，源头是古法语 guider（引导）。

items.en: The root meant to show the way.
items.cn: 该词根意为指路。

items.en: Guider meant to lead or direct.
items.cn: guider 意为引导、指路。

items.en: Guide named a person who leads.
items.cn: guide 指带路的人。

items.en: Guidance named the act of helping.
items.cn: guidance 指帮助与指引的行为。

items.en: The word also named machine steering.
items.cn: 这个词也指机器制导。

note.en: Guidance is compared with look-alike words and words for advice.
note.cn: 把 guidance 与形近词以及表示建议的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who shows the way
a rule or piece of advice
a person who protects a place
an opinion about what to do
information on how to do something

normalIntro.en: Guidance is the helping hand of advice, for people or for machines.
normalIntro.cn: guidance 是建议伸出的援手，既对人，也对机器。

normal.en: She worked under his guidance.
The school gives career guidance.
Children need moral guidance.
The missile has a guidance system.
Ask a teacher for guidance.

abstract.en: A lamp does not walk, yet it guides.
abstract.cn: 灯不会走路，却能引路。

abstract.en: Good advice leaves the choice open.
abstract.cn: 好的指导，把选择权留给对方。

abstract.en: Guidance is a hand that points, not carries.
abstract.cn: 指导是一只手，指方向而不是替你走。

examples.en: The teacher gave her patient guidance.
examples.cn: 老师给了她耐心的指导。

examples.en: The rocket uses a new guidance system.
examples.cn: 火箭使用新的制导系统。

examples.en: The school offers career guidance.

dict_mnemonic.text: guidance 是不可数名词，意为「指导、引导、制导」；under the guidance of 是在……指导下，career guidance 是职业指导；动词形式是 guide。

root: 由 guide 加名词后缀 -ance 构成，源头是古法语 guider（引导）；由对人的指路、建议，扩展到对飞行器的制导。

sensesIntro.en: Guidance means help and advice, a steering system, or official study advice.
sensesIntro.cn: guidance 指帮助与建议、制导系统，或正式的学业职业辅导。

core.en: A hand pointing the way without walking it.
core.cn: 一只指路却不代走的手。

branches.en: A teacher leans over a desk.
branches.cn: 老师俯身在书桌旁。

branches.en: A rocket corrects its own path.
branches.cn: 火箭自行修正航线。

branches.en: A student reads a career leaflet.
branches.cn: 学生翻看职业介绍单。

branches.en: People and machines both need steering.
branches.cn: 人与机器，都需要被引导。

branches.en: Personal help becomes an official service.
branches.cn: 个人的帮助，变成正式的服务。

intro.en: Guidance links to guide and its verb forms.
intro.cn: guidance 与 guide 及其动词形式相连。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word came through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，经古法语传入。

items.exampleCN: 我们参加了有导游的游览。

items.example: She is the guiding hand here.

items.exampleCN: 错误的标志会误导司机。

definition_en: a person who shows the way, a book of information, or to lead someone
core_image: 向导举着小旗带游客穿过老城
scene: 向导带我们穿过老城。The guide led us through the old town.
sceneCN: 这里 guide 是「向导」（第 1 个义项）；句意：向导带我们穿过老城。

senses.title: Person who shows the way
senses.definition: a person who leads others to a place
senses.definitionCN: 带别人去某地的人
senses.example: The guide led us through the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 向导带我们穿过老城。
senses.why: This is the central concrete sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最核心的具体义项。

senses.title: Book of information
senses.definition: a book that gives information about a place or subject
senses.definitionCN: 介绍某地或某主题信息的书
senses.example: She bought a guide to the city.
senses.exampleCN: 她买了一本城市指南。
senses.why: A book does the work of a guide.
senses.whyCN: 书承担了向导的职能。

senses.title: Lead the way
senses.definition: to show someone the way or help them decide
senses.definitionCN: 为某人指路或帮助其作决定
senses.example: He guided the team through the forest.
senses.exampleCN: 他带领队伍穿过森林。
senses.why: The verb names the guide's action.
senses.whyCN: 动词义就是向导的动作。

intro.en: Guide comes from Old French guider, to lead, probably from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: guide 来自古法语 guider（引导），可能源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant to show or know the way.
items.cn: 该词根意为指路或识路。

items.en: Guider meant to lead or direct.
items.cn: guider 意为引导、带领。

items.en: Guide named a person who leads.
items.cn: guide 指带路的人。

items.en: Guide books took the same name.
items.cn: 旅行指南也用了这个词。

items.en: The verb sense widened to advice.
items.cn: 动词义扩展到「指导、建议」。

note.en: Guide is compared with look-alike words and words for leading.
note.cn: 把 guide 与形近词以及表示带领的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who protects a place
to go in front and show the way

normalIntro.en: Guide is a person, a book, or the act of showing the way.
normalIntro.cn: guide 可以是一个人、一本书，也可以是指路的动作。

normal.en: Our guide spoke three languages.
normal.cn: 我们的向导会说三种语言。

normal.en: Buy a guide before you travel.
The stars guided the sailors.
He guided me to the station.
The dog is a guide for the blind.

abstract.en: A guide walks beside, not ahead forever.
abstract.cn: 向导只是陪走一段，不会永远在前。

abstract.en: A book can be a quiet guide.
abstract.cn: 一本书，也可以是安静的向导。

abstract.en: To guide is to lend your eyes.
abstract.cn: 引导，就是把自己的眼睛借给别人。

examples.en: The guide led us through the old town.
She bought a guide to the city.
He guided the team through the forest.

dict_mnemonic.text: guide 是「向导、指南、引导」；tour guide 是导游，guide book 是旅行指南，guide dog 是导盲犬；名词 guidance 是指导。

root: 来自古法语 guider（引导），可能源于日耳曼语「识路」的词根；由带路的人扩展为指南书和引导动作。

sensesIntro.en: Guide means a person who leads, an information book, or to lead the way.
sensesIntro.cn: guide 指向导、指南书，或引导带路。

core.en: Someone or something that knows the way.
core.cn: 认得路的某个人或某样东西。

branches.en: A flag lifts above a small tour group.
branches.cn: 小旗在旅行团上方举起。

branches.en: A folded book marks the main streets.
branches.cn: 一本折起的书标出主要街道。

branches.en: A hand points toward the station.
branches.cn: 一只手指向车站。

branches.en: Person and book both answer where.
branches.cn: 人与书，都在回答「往哪走」。

branches.en: Reading and walking both follow a line.
branches.cn: 阅读与行走，都沿着一条线。

intro.en: Guide forms verb parts and a family of direction words.
intro.cn: guide 构成动词变化以及一组表示方向的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word came through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，经古法语传入。

items.exampleCN: 他们参加了有向导的徒步。

items.example: A guidepost stood at the bend.

definition_en: a rule or piece of advice about how to do something, or a line that helps you draw
core_image: 一份印着清晰条目的安全准则文件
scene: 公司发布了新的安全指导方针。The company issued new safety guidelines.
sceneCN: 这里 guideline 是「指导方针」（第 1 个义项）；句意：公司发布了新的安全指导方针。

senses.title: Official rule of advice
senses.definition: an official rule or piece of advice on how to act
senses.definitionCN: 关于如何行动的正式规则或建议
senses.example: The company issued new safety guidelines.
senses.exampleCN: 公司发布了新的安全指导方针。
senses.why: This is the main modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代主要义项。

senses.title: Standard to follow
senses.definition: a standard used to judge or decide something
senses.definitionCN: 用来判断或决定事物的标准
senses.example: The board set clear guidelines for pay.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会为薪酬制定了明确的准则。
senses.why: Advice became a standard of judgment.
senses.whyCN: 建议变成了判断的标准。

senses.title: Drawing aid
senses.definition: a light line drawn to help keep a design straight
senses.definitionCN: 为保持设计平直而画的浅线
senses.example: Erase the guideline after drawing.
senses.exampleCN: 画完后擦掉辅助线。
senses.why: The literal line came first in design work.
senses.whyCN: 设计工作中先有字面意义上的「线」。

intro.en: Guideline joins guide, to lead, with line; the word first named a light drawing line.
intro.cn: guideline 由 guide（引导）与 line（线）组合而成，最初指绘画用的浅线。

items.en: The root of guide meant to show the way.
