senses.title: The natural home of a species
senses.definition: the natural environment in which a particular plant or animal lives and finds food, shelter and the conditions it needs
senses.definitionCN: 某种植物或动物自然生活、并获得食物、庇护和所需条件的环境
senses.example: Drainage destroyed the habitat of several native frogs.
senses.exampleCN: 排水工程毁掉了数种本地蛙类的栖息地。
senses.why: The Latin word is literally 'it inhabits'. A habitat is not a house that someone builds but a place an organism already occupies because the conditions suit it; the core image is a creature entering a place prepared by nature.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁词字面就是“它居住”。栖息地不是谁建造的房子，而是生物因条件合适而本来就占据的地方；核心意象是一只生物走进一片由自然备好的地方。

senses.title: The recorded locality of a species
senses.definition: the specific locality recorded for a plant or animal in its scientific description, or the area over which it occurs
senses.definitionCN: 科学描述中为某种动植物记录的特定地点，或该物种出现的区域
senses.example: The type specimen's habitat is a single valley in Yunnan.
senses.exampleCN: 那份模式标本的产地是云南的一条山谷。
senses.why: In 1762 the word began as a technical label in Latin descriptions of plants and animals: the part of the entry that told readers where the species lives. It names a point on the map, not a way of life.
senses.whyCN: 1762 年，这个词最初是拉丁文动植物描述中的一个技术标签：条目里告诉读者该物种住在哪里的一部分。它命名的是地图上的一点，而不是一种生活方式。

senses.title: A type of living space: wetland, forest, reef
senses.titleCN: 生境类型：湿地、森林、礁区
senses.definition: a category of environment defined by its physical conditions and the community of organisms it supports
senses.definitionCN: 由其物理条件及所供养的生物群落所定义的一类环境
senses.example: Coral reefs are the most diverse marine habitat.
senses.exampleCN: 珊瑚礁是多样性最高的海洋生境。
senses.why: Once many species' places are compared, the word groups them by type. The same 'place where life fits' becomes a category, so one can speak of a wetland habitat or a forest habitat.
senses.whyCN: 当许多物种的地方被放在一起比较，这个词就按类型把它们归类。同一个“生命得以安放之处”变成了类别，于是可以说湿地生境或森林生境。

senses.title: A designed home in captivity
senses.titleCN: 圈养环境：人工布置的栖息处
senses.definition: an enclosure or setting designed to imitate an animal's natural conditions in a zoo, aquarium, or laboratory
senses.definitionCN: 在动物园、水族馆或实验室中模仿动物自然条件而设计的围栏或环境
senses.example: The keepers rebuilt the enclosure to give the otters a more natural habitat.
senses.exampleCN: 饲养员重建了围栏，给水獭一个更自然的栖息环境。
senses.why: Here humans draw the boundary and supply the conditions. The word still means 'where the animal lives', but the place is now made rather than found.
senses.whyCN: 这里由人划定边界、提供条件。词义仍是“动物生活的地方”，但这片地方是被造出来的，而不是被找到的。

senses.title: Human or constructed living environment
senses.titleCN: 人类或人造的居住环境
senses.definition: a place designed for humans or other organisms to live in, including space stations and imagined colonies
senses.definitionCN: 为人类或其他生物居住而设计的地方，包括空间站与设想的定居点
senses.example: Engineers tested how a sealed lunar habitat would recycle water.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师测试了一座密封的月球居住舱将如何循环用水。
senses.why: The word extends from animals to humans when the emphasis is on the conditions that make life possible. A space habitat is an environment engineered to keep a living community alive.
senses.whyCN: 当重点落在“使生命得以维持的条件”上，这个词便从动物扩展到人类。太空居住舱就是一个为维持生命群落而工程化设计的环境。

senses.title: A micro-habitat for microbes
senses.definition: the specific small-scale conditions in which a microorganism or a cell population lives, such as a gut or a hot spring
senses.definitionCN: 微生物或细胞群体生活的特定小尺度条件，如肠道或温泉
senses.example: The acidic pool is a habitat for bacteria found nowhere else.
senses.exampleCN: 这个酸性水潭是别处找不到的细菌的栖息地。
senses.why: Scale is irrelevant to the core image: a few millilitres of hot spring can be as much a home as a forest, as long as the conditions fit the organism.
senses.whyCN: 尺度与核心意象无关：几毫升的温泉水和一片森林一样可以成为家，只要条件适合该生物。

senses.title: Figurative: a place where something thrives
senses.titleCN: 比喻：某事物得以繁衍的土壤
senses.definition: a setting or environment in which a particular activity, idea, or group can grow and persist
senses.definitionCN: 某种活动、观念或群体得以生长并持续的环境
senses.example: The old harbour became a habitat for small theatres and cheap studios.
senses.exampleCN: 旧港区成了小剧场和廉价工作室的滋生地。
senses.why: The biological meaning is transferred to ideas and institutions: if a place supplies the conditions that let a thing live, then it is that thing's habitat, even without soil or water.
senses.whyCN: 生物义被转移到观念与机构：如果一个地方提供了让某事物存活的条件，那它就是该事物的栖息地，哪怕没有土壤和水。

senses.title: Older general sense: a dwelling place
senses.definition: in 19th-century general use, simply a place where a person or thing dwells; now mostly literary or technical
senses.definitionCN: 在 19 世纪的一般用法中，泛指人或物居住的地方；现在多用于文学或技术语境
senses.example: The cottage had been his habitat for forty years.
senses.exampleCN: 那间小屋曾是他四十年的居所。
senses.why: The general sense 'dwelling place' is recorded from 1854, before ecology fixed the word to non-human life. Modern usage usually keeps habitat for organisms and leaves human homes to habitation or home.
senses.whyCN: “居住地”这一泛义从 1854 年就有记录，早于生态学把这个词固定用于非人类生命。现代用法通常把 habitat 留给生物，把人的住所交给 habitation 或「住所」一类的词。

intro.en: Habitat is a Latin verb form that English borrowed as a scientific noun: literally 'it inhabits'. Dates and the ecological extension are approximate.
intro.cn: habitat 是一个被英语当作科学名词借入的拉丁语动词形式，字面意为“它居住”。年代与生态学扩展的时间为大致估计。

items.en: First recorded as a technical term in Latin texts on English flora and fauna. It was the Modern Latin word beginning the part of a species description that told its locality.
items.cn: 最早记录于 1762 年，是英国动植物拉丁文志书中的技术术语。它是现代拉丁语词，用在物种描述中说明产地的那一部分开头。

items.en: Habitat is literally 'it inhabits', the third person singular present indicative of Latin habitare 'to live, dwell, inhabit'.
items.cn: habitat 字面就是“它居住”，是拉丁语 habitare“生活、居住、栖居”的第三人称单数现在时直陈式。

items.en: Habitare is a frequentative of habere 'to have, hold, possess', so dwelling was pictured as holding a place. English also took habit, inhabit and habitation from the same stem.
items.cn: habitare 是 habere“拥有、握有、占有”的反复动词，因此“居住”被想象成“握有一个地方”。英语也从同一词干借入 habit、inhabit 与 habitation。

items.en: Habere is reconstructed to PIE *ghabh- 'to give or receive', whose basic sense was probably 'to hold'. The root is reconstructed, not attested in writing.
items.cn: habere 被重构为原始印欧语 *ghabh-“给予或接受”，其基本义很可能是“握有”。该词根是重构的，没有书面文献直接记录。

items.en: The general sense 'dwelling place' is first attested in 1854, showing the word escaping from purely botanical and zoological writing.
items.cn: “居住地”这一泛义最早见于 1854 年，说明这个词开始越出纯粹的植物学与动物学写作。

items.en: Ecology turns habitat into a central countable noun: habitat loss, habitat fragmentation, habitat restoration. The compounds belong to modern conservation language rather than to the Latin source.
items.cn: 生态学把 habitat 变成核心的可数名词：habitat loss、habitat fragmentation、habitat restoration。这些复合词属于现代保护生物学语言，而不是拉丁语源。

note.en: The first group separates habitat from the words built on the same habere stem, since they look close but describe different things; the second group compares the scales and units of the living environment.
note.cn: 第一组把 habitat 与同一 habere 词干上的词分开，因为它们形近却描述不同事物；第二组比较“生存环境”的不同尺度与单位。

entries.definition: the act of living in a place, or a place to live in, especially a human dwelling. Habitat is where a species lives; habitation is the human act or building of living there.
entries.definitionCN: 居住的行为，或居住的地方，尤指人的住所。habitat 是物种生活之处；habitation 是人居住的行为或建筑。

entries.definition: to live or dwell in a place. It is the verb that habitat presupposes: a habitat is the place that a species inhabits.
entries.definitionCN: 居住于某地。它是 habitat 所预设的动词：栖息地就是某物种栖居的地方。

entries.definition: one who lives in a place, as opposed to a visitor. It names the occupant, while habitat names the occupied place.
entries.definitionCN: 居住在某地者，区别于访客。它命名占据者，而 habitat 命名被占据的地方。

entries.definition: a settled practice or tendency; also an old word for dress. It shares the 'hold' root but has nothing to do with where a species lives.
entries.definitionCN: 固定的习惯或倾向；也可旧指衣着。它共享“握有”词根，但与物种住在哪里无关。

entries.definition: the whole set of surrounding conditions, physical and social, that affect an organism. Environment is broader than habitat: it includes climate, neighbours and human pressure, not only the place occupied.
entries.definitionCN: 影响某一生物的全部周围条件，包括物理的与社会的。environment 比 habitat 更广：它包含气候、邻近生物与人类压力，而不只是被占据的地点。

entries.definition: a community of organisms together with the physical surroundings they interact with. An ecosystem is a working system; a habitat is one species' address inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 生物群落与其相互作用的物理环境之整体。ecosystem 是一个运转的系统；habitat 则是其中某一物种的“地址”。

entries.definition: the role and position a species occupies in an ecosystem, including what it eats and when it is active. Niche is the job; habitat is the workplace.
entries.definitionCN: 某物种在生态系统中的角色与位置，包括吃什么、何时活动。niche 是“职业”，habitat 是“工作场所”。

entries.definition: the entire geographical area over which a species occurs. A range may contain many habitats; a habitat is one patch of suitable conditions inside it.
entries.definitionCN: 某物种出现的整个地理区域。range 可以包含许多栖息地；habitat 则是其中一个条件合适的斑块。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin habitare 'to dwell', habere 'to hold', and the English family inhabit / inhabitant / habitation.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 habitare“居住”、habere“握有”，以及英语词族 inhabit／inhabitant／habitation。

normal.en: Habitat is a whole Latin sentence compressed into a noun: habitat = 'it lives here'. The animal is the subject, the place is the object.
normal.cn: habitat 是一个压成名词的完整拉丁句子：habitat＝“它住在这里”。动物是主语，地方是宾语。

normal.en: Inhabit is the verb, inhabitant is the person or animal, habitation is the act or building, and habitat is the place itself: four roles from one stem.
normal.cn: inhabit 是动词，inhabitant 是居住者，habitation 是居住行为或住所，habitat 是地方本身：同一词干的四种角色。

normal.en: A habit is something you hold onto and repeat; a habitat is a place a species holds. The shared idea is 'holding', not 'living'.
normal.cn: habit 是你反复握持的习惯；habitat 是一个物种握有的地方。共同的想法是“握有”，而不是“居住”。

normal.en: Habitat loss is the standard conservation phrase: the place disappears, and the species has nowhere to be its subject.
normal.cn: habitat loss 是保护生物学的标准说法：地方消失了，物种也就无处可做那个主语。

normal.en: In a zoo, the enclosure is called a habitat only when it imitates the natural conditions closely enough.
normal.cn: 在动物园里，只有足够逼真地模仿自然条件的围栏才被称为 habitat。

abstract.en: Picture a marsh at dawn: reeds, shallow water, three birds already there. Nobody invited them; the place simply fits, and that fit is habitat.
abstract.cn: 想象清晨的沼泽：芦苇、浅水、三只已经在那里的鸟。没人邀请它们，地方只是恰好合适，而这种“合适”就是 habitat。

abstract.en: Scale does not matter: a forest, a reef, a puddle, or a length of intestine can all be a habitat if the conditions let a life continue there.
abstract.cn: 尺度无关紧要：森林、礁区、水洼或一段肠道，只要条件能让生命在那里延续，都可以是栖息地。

abstract.en: Move the word from biology to culture and the same logic holds: whatever supplies the conditions for a thing to live is that thing's habitat.
abstract.cn: 把这个词从生物学移到文化上，逻辑仍然成立：凡是提供某事物存活条件的地方，就是该事物的栖息地。

examples.en: The dam cut the river's flow and dried out the habitat downstream.
examples.cn: 大坝截断了河流的水量，使下游的栖息地干涸。

examples.en: Polar bears are hard to study in their habitat because the ice is moving.
examples.cn: 北极熊在自然栖息地中很难研究，因为冰面一直在移动。

examples.en: The abandoned rail yard became a habitat for foxes, moths and rare grasses.
examples.cn: 废弃的铁路场成了狐狸、飞蛾与稀有草类的栖息地。

dict_mnemonic.text: “哈比塔特”——哈比（鸟）塔（搭）特（别）舒服的窝，住进去就不走了 → habitat 栖息地

root: 拉丁语 habitat 字面意为“它居住”，源自 habitare“居住”、habere“握有”，核心是“生命自己走进并占住的一片合适之地”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of habitat, all grown from one relation: a living thing and a place whose conditions fit it, so that the place becomes where it lives.
sensesIntro.cn: habitat 的八个义项都从同一种关系长出来：一个生命与一片条件合适的地方，于是这片地方成为它生活之处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a creature enters a place whose conditions already suit it and settles there.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只生物走进一片条件本就适合它的地方，并在那里安顿下来。

branches.en: NATURAL HOME: one species' place and a whole class of places such as wetland or reef both answer the same question — where does life fit?
branches.cn: 天然家园：单一物种的地方与湿地、礁区等整类地方，回答的都是同一个问题——生命在哪里合适？

branches.en: LOCALITY: in a scientific description the word narrows to a point on the map, the recorded place where the species was found.
branches.cn: 产地：在科学描述中，这个词收窄为地图上的一点，即记录到该物种的地点。

branches.en: MADE AND MICRO: a zoo enclosure or a hot spring is still a habitat if the conditions, however constructed or small, let the organism live.
branches.cn: 人造与微观：动物园围栏或温泉仍是栖息地，只要条件——无论多么人工或微小——能让该生物存活。

branches.en: HUMAN: the word moves to engineered living environments such as space stations, where the point is keeping a community alive.
branches.cn: 人类：这个词移到空间站等工程化居住环境，重点在于维持一个生命群落的存续。

branches.en: EXTENSION: ideas can have a habitat too, and the old general sense simply called any dwelling place a habitat.
branches.cn: 扩展：观念也可以有栖息地；旧有的泛义则把任何居住地都称作 habitat。

intro.en: Habitat is not built from an English prefix at all: it is a Latin verb ending borrowed as a noun. Its apparent parts belong to Latin, and English later adds -ant, -ation, -able and in- to the same stem.
intro.cn: habitat 根本不是由英语前缀构成的：它是把拉丁语动词词尾当作名词借入。它表面上的成分属于拉丁语，英语后来又在同一词干上加 -ant、-ation、-able 与 in-。

latinIntro.en: The family rests on habere 'to have, hold, possess' and its frequentative habitare 'to dwell'. Habitare gives habitat, habitation and inhabit; habere also gives habit, able and exhibit through older French and Latin paths.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词族建立在 habere“拥有、握有、占有”及其反复动词 habitare“居住”上。habitare 给出 habitat、habitation、inhabit；habere 还经由较早的法语和拉丁语路径给出 habit、able、exhibit。

items.meaningCN: 居住于；栖居于（in- 在内 + habitare 居住）
items.example: Few fish can inhabit water this warm.
items.exampleCN: 很少有鱼能栖居在这么温暖的水里。

items.meaning: one who lives in a place
items.meaningCN: 居民；栖居者（-ant 表示施事者）
items.example: The island's only inhabitants are seabirds.
items.exampleCN: 岛上唯一的居民是海鸟。

items.meaning: the act of dwelling, or a dwelling place
items.meaningCN: 居住；住所（-ion 构成行为或地点名词）
items.example: The valley shows signs of human habitation for centuries.
items.exampleCN: 这条山谷显示出数百年人类居住的痕迹。

items.meaningCN: 可居住的；适宜居住的（-able 表示能够被）
items.example: The planet lies just inside the habitable zone.
items.exampleCN: 这颗行星恰好位于宜居带内侧。

items.meaningCN: 无人居住的；荒无人烟的
items.example: The island was uninhabited for most of the year.
items.exampleCN: 这座岛一年中大部分时间无人居住。

items.meaning: to live together, especially as a couple
items.meaningCN: 同居；共同居住（co- 共同 + 居住）
items.example: The two species cohabit in the same cave.
items.exampleCN: 这两个物种共同栖息在同一洞穴中。

items.structure: Latin habitus 'condition, demeanour, dress', from habere
items.meaning: a settled practice; also an old word for clothing
items.meaningCN: 习惯；旧指衣着（来自拉丁语 habitus“状态、举止、衣着”）
items.example: Reading before sleep had become a habit.
items.exampleCN: 睡前阅读已成了一种习惯。

items.meaningCN: 习惯性的；惯常的（-ual 构成形容词）
items.example: His habitual lateness annoyed the group.
items.exampleCN: 他惯常的迟到让全组不满。

items.meaning: to accustom someone or something to a condition
items.example: Animals habituate quickly to the sound of the generator.
items.exampleCN: 动物很快会习惯发电机的声音。

items.meaning: to hold out for others to see; to display
items.meaningCN: 展出；显示（ex- 向外 + habere 握有）
items.example: The museum exhibits specimens from the same habitat.
items.exampleCN: 博物馆展出来自同一栖息地的标本。

items.meaning: having the power or skill to do something
items.meaningCN: 能够的；有能力的（同一“握有”词根经法语演变）
items.example: The team was able to map the whole habitat.
items.exampleCN: 团队得以绘制整个栖息地的地图。

latinEntries.meaning: a dwelling; the act of dwelling

definition_zh: 惯常的；已成习惯的；惯犯的；语法惯常体的
definition_en: done regularly because of habit, or describing a person who does something regularly
core_image: 门卫不看钟就打开侧门，因为身体已经记住了那个时刻，动作先于念头
scene: 门卫每天在同一时刻打开侧门，从不抬头看钟，因为身体已经记住了那个时间点。The habitual early riser had finished two chapters before the household woke.
sceneCN: 这里本词指长期形成、几乎自动的（第 1 个义项：因习惯而反复发生的）；句意为这位惯于早起的人在家人都醒来前已读完两章。

derivatives.zh: 去掉形容词后缀后得到名词，语义为「习惯、习性」
由本词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「习惯性地」
由名词加表「使成为」的动词后缀构成，语义偏移为「使习惯」
由动词加表动作或结果的后缀构成，语义偏移为「习惯化」
由名词与表「形成」的分词复合构成，语义偏移为「易使人成瘾的」

senses.title: Done by habit
senses.definition: repeated so often that it is done automatically
senses.definitionCN: 反复到自动进行的
senses.example: The habitual early riser had finished two chapters before the household woke.
senses.exampleCN: 这位惯于早起的人在家人都醒来前已读完两章。
senses.why: The adjective is the noun of habit plus a suffix meaning 'of that kind', so it describes what belongs to a habit.
senses.whyCN: 该形容词由「习惯」这一名词加表「属于该类」的后缀构成，因此描述由习惯而来的行为。

senses.title: Of a person who regularly does something
senses.definition: describing a person who does something as a settled pattern
senses.definitionCN: 描述把某事做成固定模式的人
senses.example: The habitual walker knew every bend of the road.
senses.exampleCN: 这位惯常走路的人熟悉这条路的每个弯。
senses.why: The suffix can describe the person as well as the act, since a habit belongs to its bearer.
senses.whyCN: 该后缀既能描述行为，也能描述人，因为习惯属于其持有者。

senses.title: Of a repeat offender in law
senses.definition: in law, describing someone repeatedly convicted of the same offence
senses.definitionCN: 法律上描述屡次因同类罪行被定罪的人
senses.example: The court treated him as a habitual offender.
senses.exampleCN: 法院把他视为惯犯。
senses.why: Law takes repeated behaviour and gives it a formal name with the same adjective.
senses.whyCN: 法律接过「反复行为」，用同一形容词给了它正式名称。

senses.title: Of a regular customer or visitor
senses.definition: describing someone who comes to a place as a matter of course
senses.definitionCN: 描述照例常来某处的人
senses.example: The cafe saves a seat for its habitual guests.
senses.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆为老主顾留一个座位。
senses.why: A repeated visit is a habit too, so shops apply the word to regulars.
senses.whyCN: 反复光顾也是一种习惯，店家便用它指常客。

senses.title: Of repeated drug use
senses.definition: describing use that has become a compulsion
senses.definitionCN: 描述已变成强迫性依赖的使用
senses.example: Habitual use of the drug damages the liver.
senses.exampleCN: 习惯性使用该药物会损害肝脏。
senses.why: The medical sense keeps the idea of repetition but adds the grip of compulsion.
senses.whyCN: 医学义保留「反复」，又加上强迫性抓握的含义。

senses.title: Of a species' fixed behaviour
senses.definition: describing behaviour that a species reliably shows
senses.definitionCN: 描述某物种稳定呈现的行为
senses.example: Habitual nest building begins before the rains.
senses.exampleCN: 固有的筑巢行为在雨季前开始。
senses.why: Ethology borrows the adjective for patterns fixed across a species.
senses.whyCN: 动物行为学借用该形容词指整个物种固定的行为模式。

senses.title: Done from routine, without thought
senses.definition: done because it is the usual course, with little attention
senses.definitionCN: 因循惯例、不加留意的
senses.example: A habitual nod was his only reply.
senses.exampleCN: 一个机械的点头就是他唯一的回应。
senses.why: Repetition without attention is the dark side of habit, and the adjective carries it.
senses.whyCN: 不加留意的重复是习惯的另一面，该形容词也带上这层意思。

senses.title: Of the grammatical aspect for repeated events
senses.definition: in grammar, marking an action that is repeated as a rule
senses.definitionCN: 语法中标记按规律反复发生的动作
senses.example: Some languages mark habitual aspect with a separate suffix.
senses.exampleCN: 有些语言用单独的后缀标记惯常体。
senses.why: Grammar names the form that presents an action as customary, borrowing the adjective directly.
senses.whyCN: 语法用这个形容词直接命名把动作呈现为惯例的形式。

intro.en: Habitual is habit plus the Latin-derived adjective suffix -ual, from Latin habitualis, itself from habitus 'condition'; the root is habere 'to hold'.
intro.cn: 本词由 habit 加源自拉丁语的形容词后缀构成，拉丁语形式出自 habitus「状态」，词根为 habere「持有」。

items.en: Habere 'to have, hold' supplied the root for a family of words about holding and condition.
items.cn: habere「拥有、持有」为一批表「持有与状态」的词提供了词根。

items.en: Habitus named a settled condition or bearing, the base of the English noun.
items.cn: habitus 指稳定的状态或举止，是英语名词的基础。

items.en: Habitualis added an adjective suffix meaning 'of the kind of', so it described what belongs to a condition.
items.cn: 加上表「属于该类」的形容词后缀后，它描述属于某种状态的东西。

items.en: The adjective reached English through French in the medieval period, applied first to states of body and mind.
items.cn: 该形容词在中世纪经法语进入英语，最初用于身体与心智的状态。

items.en: Law used it for repeat offenders, and grammar for repeated events, each narrowing the same idea of the customary.
items.cn: 法律用它指惯犯，语法用它指反复事件，各自把「惯例性」收窄。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the Indo-European base behind habere is generally considered to be a reconstruction; the earliest English use is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：habere 背后的印欧词基一般认为是重构形式；最早英语用例年代并不精确。

note.en: Group one holds close forms from the same holding root; group two holds adjectives for what is usual and repeated.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「持有」词根的形近形式；第二组是表示「通常、反复」的形容词。

entries.definition: The noun naming the repeated pattern; it is what the adjective qualifies.
entries.definitionCN: 指那种反复模式的名词，正是本词所修饰的对象。

entries.definition: The adverb saying that something is done by habit; it answers how, not which.
entries.definitionCN: 表「出于习惯地」的副词，回答「怎样」而非「哪一个」。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to accustom someone, formed with a suffix meaning 'make'.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「使某人习惯」的动词，由表「使成为」的后缀构成。

entries.definition: From the same root through a dwelling verb; it names a living place, not a repeated act.
entries.definitionCN: 同根词经表居住的动词而来，指生活场所，而非反复行为。

entries.definition: Fixed by the usage of a community rather than by one person's repetition.
entries.definitionCN: 由群体习俗确定，而非由个人反复形成。

entries.definition: Describing someone who has become used to a condition, with less stress on the act itself.
entries.definitionCN: 描述已习惯某种状况的人，对行为本身的强调较弱。

entries.definition: Happening at even intervals; habitual stresses the grip of repetition, not the timetable.
entries.definitionCN: 按均匀间隔发生；本词强调反复的黏着，而非时间表。

entries.definition: Describing a condition or behaviour lasting a long time, often with harmful effect.
entries.definitionCN: 描述持续很久的状况或行为，常带害处。

entries.definition: Describing a habit or attitude fixed by long use, stronger and more literary than habitual.
entries.definitionCN: 描述因长期沿袭而固定的习惯或态度，比本词更强、更书面。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective is the habit noun plus a suffix meaning 'of that kind'.
normal.cn: 该形容词由「习惯」名词加表「属于该类」的后缀构成。

normal.en: The family runs habit, habitual, habitually, habituate, habituation.
normal.cn: 同族词包括习惯、惯常的、习惯性地、使习惯、习惯化。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: habitual offender, habitual smoker, habitual behaviour.
normal.cn: 固定说法：惯犯、惯常吸烟者、惯常行为。

normal.en: Law and grammar each borrow the adjective for their own kind of repetition.
normal.cn: 法律与语法各自借用该形容词来指自己领域的反复。

normal.en: The root family also gives habitat and inhabit, which are about place rather than repetition.
normal.cn: 同根词族还给出栖息地与居住，关乎地点而非反复。

abstract.en: Picture a hand finding the gate latch in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在黑暗里摸到门闩。

abstract.en: Picture a road with two ruts so deep that wheels no longer choose.
abstract.cn: 想象一条车辙深到车轮不再需要选择的路。

abstract.en: Picture a clock that runs a minute fast, and every schedule quietly follows it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只快一分钟的钟，所有日程都悄悄跟着它走。

examples.en: Habitual lateness cost him the job.
examples.cn: 惯常迟到让他丢了工作。

examples.en: The study tracked habitual readers over ten years.
examples.cn: 这项研究跟踪了有阅读习惯的人十年。

examples.en: A habitual offender faces a longer sentence.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「习惯」加表「属于该类」的形容词后缀——属于习惯的那一类，就是惯常的、已成习惯的。

root: 拉丁 habitualis，出自 habitus「状态、举止」，词根为 habere「拥有、持有」；形容词后缀表「属于该类」，因此指属于某种反复状态的；更深词基一般认为是重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one adjective: what belongs to a repeated pattern describes an act that runs itself, a person who runs it, an offender in law, a regular guest, a compulsion, a species, a mechanical nod and a grammatical aspect.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个形容词展开：凡属于反复模式者，可描述自行运转的行为、其人、法律上的惯犯、常客、依赖、物种、机械的点头与语法体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gateman opening the side door at the same minute without looking at the clock.
core.cn: 核心意象：门卫在同一分钟打开侧门，却不抬头看钟。

branches.en: OF THE ACT: the plain sense describes an act that repeats itself.
branches.cn: 属于行为：最普通的义项描述自行重复的行为。

branches.en: OF THE PERSON: the habit belongs to the one who carries it.
branches.cn: 属于其人：习惯属于持有它的人。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONAL LABELS: law names repeat offenders, commerce names regular guests.
branches.cn: 机构标签：法律点名惯犯，商业点名常客。

branches.en: TIGHTENED AND THINNED: compulsion is repetition with a grip, mechanical routine is repetition without attention.
branches.cn: 收紧与变薄：成瘾是带抓握的重复，机械例行是不带留意的重复。

branches.en: FIXED FORMS: a species and a grammatical aspect both fix repetition into a rule.
branches.cn: 固定形式：物种与语法体都把反复固定为规则。

intro.en: Habitual is a noun of condition plus an adjective suffix, and the same two parts reappear in many English adjectives, so the word can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: 本词是表状态的名词加形容词后缀，同样的两部分见于许多英语形容词，因此可按语素读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin habere supplies the root through habitus, and the adjective suffix meaning 'of the kind of' also appears in English words such as the one for annual.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表「持有」的动词经其状态名词提供词根，表「属于该类」的形容词后缀也见于英语中表示「每年的」等词。

items.example: The root carries the idea of something held.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根承载「被持有」的意思。

items.example: The noun named a settled condition.
items.exampleCN: 这一名词指稳定的状态。

items.example: The habitual riser beat the alarm.
items.exampleCN: 惯于早起的人比闹钟起得早。
饲养员让动物习惯噪声。
这种糖浆容易使人成瘾。

items.example: The habitualness of the gesture went unnoticed.
items.exampleCN: 这个动作的惯常性无人注意。

derivatives.zh: 去掉形容词后缀后得到名词，语义为「习惯」
由本词加表方式的副词后缀构成，语义偏移为「习惯性地」
由名词加表「使成为」的动词后缀构成，语义偏移为「使习惯」
由动词加表动作或结果的后缀构成，语义偏移为「习惯化」
由名词与表「形成」的分词复合构成，语义偏移为「易使人成瘾的」
由本词加表性质的名词后缀构成，语义偏移为「惯常性」

definition_zh: 冰雹；一阵冰雹；下冰雹；如雹般袭来；（同形异源）招呼、欢呼
definition_en: frozen pellets of ice that fall from a thunderstorm, or to fall as such pellets
core_image: 乌云压顶，豆大的冰粒砸在铁皮棚顶上，噼啪作响，滚得满地都是
scene: 豆大的冰粒砸在铁皮棚顶上，噼啪作响。Hail rattled on the tin roof like gravel.
sceneCN: 这里该词指「从天落下的冰粒」（第 1 个义项：冰雹这一冻结降水）；句意为冰雹砸在铁皮屋顶上，响声像碎石。

pos.zh: 向……招呼；欢呼（同形异源的另一词）

derivatives.zh: 冰雹的；多冰雹的（较少用）

senses.title: Frozen pellets falling
senses.definition: frozen balls of ice that fall from a thunderstorm
senses.definitionCN: 从雷暴云中落下的冻结冰球
senses.example: Hail rattled on the tin roof like gravel.
senses.exampleCN: 冰雹砸在铁皮屋顶上，响声像碎石。
senses.why: Hail is ice that grew in strong updraughts and became too heavy to stay in the cloud, so it arrives as hard pellets rather than flakes.
senses.whyCN: 冰雹在强上升气流中长大，重到云托不住，所以它以硬颗粒而不是薄片落地。

senses.title: A shower of hail
senses.definition: a single episode of hail falling
senses.definitionCN: 一次冰雹落下的过程
senses.example: A sudden hail drove everyone under the awning.
senses.exampleCN: 一阵突如其来的冰雹把大家赶到了雨棚下。
senses.why: Weather reports count separate episodes, so the mass noun also appears with an article as one bout.
senses.whyCN: 天气报告要数出一次次过程，所以这个物质名词也能加冠词表示一场。

senses.title: The pellets themselves
senses.definition: the individual ice pellets, considered as material
senses.definitionCN: 作为物质来看的一颗颗冰粒
senses.example: Hail covered the field in a layer of white pellets.
senses.exampleCN: 冰雹给田野盖上一层白色颗粒。
senses.why: As a mass noun, the word names the substance lying on the ground after the fall.
senses.whyCN: 作为物质名词，这个词指落下后堆在地面上的那种东西。

senses.title: Impact damage
senses.definition: hail considered as a force that breaks glass, crops and roofs
senses.definitionCN: 被视为能砸破玻璃、毁坏庄稼与屋顶的力量
senses.example: The storm's hail punched holes in the greenhouse panels.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴的冰雹把温室板砸出了洞。
senses.why: Because a pellet hits with concentrated force, the word regularly appears in damage reports.
senses.whyCN: 因为颗粒以集中的力撞击，这个词常出现在损坏报告里。

senses.title: To fall as hail
senses.definition: used as a verb meaning that hail is falling
senses.definitionCN: 作动词，表示正在下冰雹
senses.example: It hailed for ten minutes and then cleared.
senses.exampleCN: 下了十分钟冰雹，然后放晴了。
senses.why: The verb simply turns the weather event into a process, as with rain and snow.
senses.whyCN: 动词只是把天气事件变成一个过程，与 rain、snow 的用法相同。

senses.title: A hail storm
senses.definition: a storm whose main product is hail
senses.definitionCN: 主要产物为冰雹的风暴
senses.example: The hail storm stripped leaves from the vines.
senses.exampleCN: 冰雹风暴把葡萄藤的叶子打光了。
senses.why: Compound naming separates the storm from the pellets; the storm is the system, hail is what it drops.
senses.whyCN: 复合命名把风暴与冰粒分开：风暴是系统，冰雹是它落下的东西。

senses.title: A volley of flying objects
senses.definition: a large number of objects thrown or fired at once, like falling hail
senses.definitionCN: 一次抛来或射来的大量物体，如同落下的冰雹
senses.example: A hail of stones met the advancing line.
senses.exampleCN: 如雹般的石块砸向推进的队伍。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps only the density and the downward strike: many hard things arriving at once.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻只保留密度与向下砸击：许多硬东西同时到来。

senses.title: To greet or call out
senses.definition: to greet someone or call to them, as in hailing a taxi
senses.definitionCN: 向某人招呼或呼喊，如招呼出租车
senses.example: She hailed the driver from the corner of the street.
senses.exampleCN: 她在街角招呼司机。
senses.why: This is a different word that happens to share the spelling; it comes from a Germanic root meaning 'healthy, whole', not from ice.
senses.whyCN: 这是一个碰巧同形的另一个词，出自意为「健康、完整」的日耳曼词根，与冰无关。

intro.en: English has two words spelled hail. The ice word and the greeting word have separate Germanic origins and are not related; the entry keeps them apart.
intro.cn: 英语有两个拼作 hail 的词。冰雹词与招呼词各有独立的日耳曼来源，彼此无关；本条目把它们分开处理。

items.en: The ice word is Old English hægl, from Proto-Germanic *haglaz, with cognates in German Hagel and Dutch hagel.
items.cn: 冰雹词是古英语 hægl，出自原始日耳曼语 *haglaz，同源词有德语 Hagel 与荷兰语 hagel。

items.en: The usual reconstruction is PIE *kaghlo- 'pebble', which also gives Greek kakhlex 'round pebble'. The link is generally accepted but the exact form is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 通常重构为原始印欧语 *kaghlo-「小石子」，希腊语 kakhlex「圆石子」也出自此。此联系一般被接受，但确切形式属重构。

items.en: The greeting word is a different verb, from Proto-Germanic *hailjan 'to greet', related to whole, heal and health; its older sense is 'be whole, be well'.
items.cn: 招呼词是另一个动词，出自原始日耳曼语 *hailjan「致意」，与 whole、heal、health 同族；其更早义为「完整、安好」。

items.en: Both words survive into Middle English, and because they sound identical they are now written alike, though their histories remain separate.
items.cn: 两个词都进入中古英语；由于读音相同，如今拼写也相同，但各自的历史仍然分开。

items.en: The figurative 'hail of bullets' is a nineteenth-century extension of the ice image, while 'hail a taxi' extends the greeting word.
items.cn: 比喻性的「弹雨」是十九世纪对冰雹意象的延伸，而「招呼出租车」则延伸了招呼词。

note.en: Group one separates the spelling neighbours, including two true homographs; group two holds other frozen falls.
note.cn: 第一组分辨拼写相近的词，其中两个是真正的同形词；第二组是其他冻结降水。

entries.definition: Healthy and strong, as in hale and hearty; also an old verb meaning to drag. It is spelled with no i and is unrelated to ice or greeting.
entries.definitionCN: 健壮的，如 hale and hearty；也有古动词义「拖拽」。拼写无 i，与冰雹及招呼都无关。

entries.definition: The back part of the foot; the vowel is long /iː/, so it is heard as a different word from hail.
entries.definitionCN: 脚后跟；元音是长音 /iː/，听起来与 hail 不同。

entries.definition: A large room or a corridor; the vowel is /ɔː/ and the final consonant is -ll, clearly different from hail.
entries.definitionCN: 大厅或走廊；元音是 /ɔː/，词尾是 -ll，与 hail 明显不同。

entries.definition: Rain and snow mixed, or ice pellets in American usage; it is softer or wetter than hail.
entries.definitionCN: 雨雪混合，美式英语中也指冰粒；比冰雹更软或更湿。

entries.definition: Snowflakes coated with rime, forming soft white pellets; hail is harder and built in stronger updraughts.
entries.definitionCN: 被雾凇包裹的雪片形成的软白颗粒；冰雹更硬，形成于更强的上升气流。

entries.definition: A single pellet of hail; the mass noun names the material, the count noun names one piece.
entries.definitionCN: 一颗冰雹；物质名词指材料，可数名词指一个个体。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real compounds and a real homograph split, no invented links.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：使用真实复合词与真实的同形词区分，不编造联系。

normal.en: hail + stone = hailstone, one pellet; hail + storm = hailstorm, the system that drops them.
normal.cn: hail + stone = hailstone，一颗冰雹；hail + storm = hailstorm，落下它们的天气系统。

normal.en: a hail of bullets borrows the density and impact of falling ice, not its cold.
normal.cn: a hail of bullets 借用了落冰的密集与冲击，而不借它的寒冷。

normal.en: hail a taxi belongs to the greeting word, whose old sense is 'be well'; it has nothing to do with weather.
normal.cn: hail a taxi 属于招呼词，其旧义为「安好」，与天气无关。

normal.en: hail-fellow-well-met uses the greeting word and means too friendly in a false way.
normal.cn: hail-fellow-well-met 用的是招呼词，指虚情假意地过分亲热。

normal.en: the phrase hale and hearty contains the healthy word, which is why it is spelled without i.
normal.cn: hale and hearty 里用的是「健壮」那个词，所以拼写没有 i。

abstract.en: Abstractly, hail is the sky throwing hard little stones; the metaphor survives whenever many objects arrive at once.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，hail 是天空扔下的小硬石；只要许多物体同时到来，这个比喻就仍在使用。

abstract.en: The ice word and the greeting word meet only in spelling, like two strangers sharing a coat.
abstract.cn: 冰雹词与招呼词只在拼写上相遇，就像两个陌生人共用一件外套。

abstract.en: So hail covers both a violent fall and a friendly call, and the context alone decides which word is being used.
abstract.cn: 所以 hail 既指猛烈的坠落，也指友善的呼唤，只有语境能决定用的是哪个词。

examples.en: The vineyard lost half its grapes to a single hail storm.
examples.cn: 葡萄园因一场冰雹风暴损失了一半葡萄。

examples.en: Hail the size of golf balls dented the car roof.
examples.cn: 高尔夫球大小的冰雹把车顶砸出了凹坑。

examples.en: He hailed a passing bus and climbed aboard.
examples.cn: 他招呼了一辆路过的公交车，上了车。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「嗨哟」：天上砸下冰粒，人喊一声「嗨哟」 → hail 冰雹

root: 冰雹义为古英语 hægl（原始日耳曼语 *haglaz，原始印欧语 *kaghlo-「小石子」）；招呼义为另一词，出自原始日耳曼语 *hailjan「致意」，与 whole、heal 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start with hard ice pellets and follow their force: one pellet, one shower, the mass, the damage, the verb, the storm, the metaphor of a volley, and finally the unrelated greeting word that shares the spelling.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从硬冰粒开始，沿着它的力量展开：一颗、一阵、整片物质、造成的损坏、动词、风暴、齐射的比喻，最后是同形而无关的招呼词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hard ice pellets driven down by a storm, striking whatever lies below.
core.cn: 核心意象：风暴驱赶着硬冰粒向下砸，打在下面的一切东西上。

branches.en: MATERIAL: one pellet and the layer it forms are the same substance at two scales.
branches.cn: 物质：一颗冰雹与它铺成的一层，是同一物质的两个尺度。

branches.en: EVENT AND SYSTEM: a shower is the fall, a storm is the machine that produces it.
branches.cn: 事件与系统：一阵是落下本身，风暴是产生它的机器。

branches.en: FORCE: concentrated impact breaks glass, and the same image turns stones or bullets into a hail.
branches.cn: 力量：集中的撞击砸破玻璃，同一意象又让石块或子弹变成一阵「雹」。

branches.en: PROCESS: the verb simply reports that the pellets are coming down.
branches.cn: 过程：动词只是报告冰粒正在落下。

branches.en: HOMOGRAPH: the greeting word shares only spelling, coming from a root meaning 'whole, healthy'.
branches.cn: 同形词：招呼词只共享拼写，出自意为「完整、健康」的词根。

intro.en: Hail builds almost all its family by compounding with nouns for pieces and storms; the greeting homograph builds a separate small set of idioms.
intro.cn: hail 的冰雹义几乎全靠与「颗粒」「风暴」类名词复合来扩展词族；同形的招呼义则形成另一小组习语。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor. Latin grando 'hail' is a semantic parallel only, not a cognate, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁语祖先。拉丁语 grando「冰雹」只是语义对照，并非同源词，因此拉丁词条列表留空。

items.exampleCN: 一颗冰雹把挡风玻璃砸裂了。
这场冰雹风暴持续了二十分钟。

items.example: A hail shower passed over the town.
Insurance claims for hail damage doubled.
items.exampleCN: 冰雹损坏的保险索赔翻了一番。

items.meaning: the towering storm cloud in which hail grows
items.meaningCN: 冰雹在其中生成的高耸雷暴云
items.example: Radar showed a hail cloud over the ridge.
items.exampleCN: 雷达显示山脊上空有一团冰雹云。

items.meaning: to signal a taxi to stop
items.meaningCN: 招手叫停出租车（此处 hail 为招呼义）
items.example: We hailed a taxi outside the station.
items.exampleCN: 我们在车站外叫了一辆出租车。

items.meaning: to come from a place of origin
items.meaningCN: 来自某地；原籍是（hail 的另一个同形词用法）
items.example: She hails from a fishing village.

items.meaning: a prayer, or a desperate last attempt in sport
items.meaningCN: 万福马利亚祈祷；体育中指孤注一掷的最后一投
items.example: The team tried a Hail Mary at the buzzer.
items.exampleCN: 球队在终场哨响时孤注一掷。

definition_en: a large room for gatherings, the entrance space of a building, or a passage inside a building
core_image: 高顶大屋中回声荡荡的空间
scene: 客人们在大厅等候。The guests waited in the hall.
sceneCN: 这里 hall 是「大厅」（第 1 个义项）；句意：客人们在大厅等候。

senses.title: Entrance room
senses.definition: the large room just inside the entrance of a building
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物入口内的大房间
senses.example: The guests waited in the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 客人们在大厅等候。
senses.why: The entrance space is the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 入口处的空间，是最日常的义项。

senses.title: Gathering room
senses.definition: a large room used for meetings, concerts, or meals
senses.definitionCN: 用于会议、音乐会或用餐的大房间
senses.example: The concert hall was full.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐厅坐满了人。
senses.why: A room for many people is the oldest public sense.
senses.whyCN: 容纳众人的房间，是最古老的公共义项。

senses.title: Passage
senses.definition: a passage inside a building that leads to rooms
senses.definitionCN: 建筑物内通往各房间的通道
senses.example: She walked down the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 她沿着过道走去。
senses.why: The covered space between rooms took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 房间之间的有顶空间，沿用了同一名称。

intro.en: Hall comes from Old English heall, a large roofed space, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: hall 来自古英语 heall（有顶的大空间），源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root named a covered place.
items.cn: 该词根指有顶的场所。

items.en: Heall meant a large roofed building.
items.cn: heall 指有顶的大建筑。

items.en: Hall meant the main room of a house.
items.cn: hall 指房屋的主厅。

items.en: It named public rooms for meetings and music.
items.cn: 它指用于会议与音乐的公共厅堂。

items.en: It also named a passage between rooms.
items.cn: 它也指房间之间的过道。

note.en: Hall is compared with look-alike words and words for large rooms and passages.
note.cn: 把 hall 与形近词以及表示大厅与通道的词作比较。

entries.definition: the entrance hall of a building
a long passage inside a building
a large room for an audience

normalIntro.en: A hall is the big room at the door, the big room for crowds, and the long way between rooms.
normalIntro.cn: hall 是门口的大房间、容纳人群的大厅，也是房间之间的长通道。

normal.en: The guests waited in the hall.
The concert hall was full.
She walked down the hall.
The town hall opens at nine.
We ate in the dining hall.

abstract.en: A roof and a wide floor can gather a whole town.
abstract.cn: 一个屋顶和一片宽地，能聚起整座小镇。

abstract.en: A passage is a promise that rooms are near.
abstract.cn: 过道是一种承诺：房间就在近处。

abstract.en: The old great hall still echoes in the word.
abstract.cn: 古老的大厅，仍在词里回响。

examples.en: The guests waited in the hall.
The concert hall was full.
She walked down the hall.

dict_mnemonic.text: hall 是「大厅、门厅」，也指「会堂」和「过道」；town hall 是市政厅，concert hall 是音乐厅，dining hall 是食堂。

root: 来自古英语 heall（有顶的大空间），源于日耳曼语词根；由大屋顶建筑，引申为主厅、公共会堂，以及房间之间的过道。

sensesIntro.en: Hall means an entrance room, a large public room, or a passage inside a building.
sensesIntro.cn: hall 指门厅、大型公共厅堂，或建筑内的过道。

core.en: A large covered space under one roof.
core.cn: 一个大屋顶下的宽敞空间。

branches.en: Guests stand just inside the door.
branches.cn: 客人站在门内不远处。

branches.en: A crowd fills rows of seats.
branches.cn: 人群坐满一排排座位。

branches.en: Feet sound along a long passage.
branches.cn: 脚步声沿长通道响起。

branches.en: The entrance room and the public hall are both large rooms.
branches.cn: 门厅与公共大厅，都是大房间。

branches.en: The hall of crowds and the hall of passage share one roof.
branches.cn: 人群的大厅与通行的过道，共用一个屋顶。

intro.en: Hall forms plurals and compounds of rooms and furniture.
intro.cn: hall 构成复数，以及与房间和家具相关的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: a stand for coats and hats
items.example: Put your coat on the hallstand.
The concert hall seats a thousand.
He entered the hall of fame.

definition_en: to stop moving, to make someone or something stop, or a complete stop
core_image: 行军队伍听到口令立刻站住
scene: 火车在信号前停下。The train came to a halt at the signal.
sceneCN: 这里 halt 是「停顿」（第 3 个义项）；句意：火车在信号前停下。

senses.title: Stop moving
senses.definition: to stop moving or continuing
senses.definitionCN: 停止移动或继续
senses.example: The train halted at the signal.
senses.exampleCN: 火车在信号前停下。
senses.why: Stopping movement is the central sense.
senses.whyCN: 停止移动，是中心义项。

senses.title: Make it stop
senses.definition: to make someone or something stop
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物停下来
senses.example: The guard halted the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 警卫让人群停下。
senses.why: The same verb works with an object.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词也可以带宾语。

senses.title: A complete stop
senses.definition: a complete stop in movement or activity
senses.definitionCN: 移动或活动中完全停下
senses.example: The train came to a halt.
senses.exampleCN: 火车停了下来。
senses.why: The verb gave English a noun for the stop.
senses.whyCN: 动词又衍生出表示停顿的名词。

intro.en: The stopping verb halt comes from a Germanic root meaning to hold; a separate old word halt meant lame.
intro.cn: 表示停止的 halt 来自意为「持有」的日耳曼语词根；另有一个古老的 halt 意为瘸的。

items.en: The root meant to hold or keep.
items.cn: 该词根意为持有或保持。

items.en: Healtian meant to limp, a separate word.
items.cn: healtian 意为跛行，是另一个词。

items.en: A military command halt came from the holding root.
items.cn: 军队口令 halt 来自表示持有的词根。

items.en: It came to mean a stop in movement.
items.cn: 它转而表示移动的中止。

items.en: The noun sense of a pause appeared.
items.cn: 表示停顿的名词义出现。

note.en: Halt is compared with look-alike words and words for stopping.
note.cn: 把 halt 与形近词以及表示停止的词作比较。

entries.definition: a white substance used in food
to stop for a short time

normalIntro.en: Halt is to stop, to make something stop, or the stop itself.
normalIntro.cn: halt 是停下、使某物停下，或停顿本身。

normal.en: The train halted at the signal.
The guard halted the crowd.
The train came to a halt.
Rain brought the game to a halt.
The factory ground to a halt.

abstract.en: To stop is also to hold oneself in place.
abstract.cn: 停下，也是把自己按在原处。

abstract.en: A command can end a march in one word.
abstract.cn: 一句口令，就能结束一次行军。

abstract.en: A pause is not an end, only a held breath.
abstract.cn: 停顿不是终结，只是一口屏住的气。

examples.en: The train halted at the signal.
The guard halted the crowd.
The train came to a halt.

dict_mnemonic.text: halt 是「停止」或「使停下」，也作名词表示「停顿」；come to a halt 是停下来，bring to a halt 是使停止，grind to a halt 是逐渐停顿。

root: 表示停止的 halt 来自日耳曼语「持有」词根，经军队口令进入英语；把队伍按住不动，引申为停止、使停下与停顿。

sensesIntro.en: Halt means to stop, to make something stop, or a complete stop.
sensesIntro.cn: halt 指停止、使某物停下，或完全停顿。

core.en: Holding movement in place.
core.cn: 把移动按住不动。

branches.en: A train slows to a stop.
branches.cn: 火车减速停下。

branches.en: A hand is raised before a crowd.
branches.cn: 一只手在人群前举起。

branches.en: Silence follows a command.
branches.cn: 口令之后一片安静。

branches.en: To stop and to make stop are one action seen twice.
branches.cn: 停下与使停下，是同一个动作的两面。

branches.en: The act of stopping becomes the name of the stop.
branches.cn: 停止的动作，成了停顿的名称。

intro.en: Halt forms verb parts and adverbs of hesitant speech.
intro.cn: halt 构成动词变化，以及表示迟疑言语的副词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the stopping word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，表示停止的 halt 属日耳曼语。

items.example: The unhalting flow wore the stone.
items.exampleCN: 不停的水流磨蚀了石头。

definition_en: to deal with a situation, to operate something, the part of an object made to be held, or to touch with the hands
core_image: 一只手握住门把转动
scene: 她处理问题很冷静。She handled the problem calmly.
sceneCN: 这里 handle 是「处理」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她处理问题很冷静。

senses.title: Deal with
senses.definition: to deal with a situation, problem, or person
senses.definitionCN: 应对情况、问题或人
senses.example: She handled the problem calmly.
senses.exampleCN: 她处理问题很冷静。
senses.why: Dealing with matters is the central modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 处理事务，是核心的现代义项。

senses.title: Operate
senses.definition: to use or control a machine or tool
senses.definitionCN: 使用或控制机器或工具
senses.example: He knows how to handle the machine.
senses.exampleCN: 他知道怎样操作这台机器。
senses.why: To handle a thing is to make it work with the hands.
senses.whyCN: 操作一件东西，就是用手让它运转。

senses.title: Grip part
senses.definition: the part of an object made for the hand to hold
senses.definitionCN: 器物上供手握的部分
senses.example: The handle of the cup is broken.
senses.exampleCN: 杯子的把手断了。
senses.why: The noun names the place the hand takes.
senses.whyCN: 名词指手所握的位置。

senses.title: Touch
senses.definition: to touch or hold something with your hands
senses.definitionCN: 用手触摸或拿着某物
senses.example: Wash your hands after handling raw meat.
senses.exampleCN: 接触生肉后要洗手。
senses.why: The oldest sense is feeling something with the hands.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项，是用手去感触。

intro.en: Handle comes from Old English handlian, to feel or touch with the hands, from hand.
intro.cn: handle 来自古英语 handlian（用手触摸），源于 hand。

items.en: Handlian meant to touch or use with the hands.
items.cn: handlian 意为用手触摸或使用。

items.en: Handlen meant to touch or deal with.
items.cn: handlen 意为触摸或处理。

items.en: Handle named the part made for the hand.
items.cn: handle 指为手而设的部分。

items.en: It came to mean managing a situation.
items.cn: 它转而表示应对局面。

items.en: It also meant operating a machine.
items.cn: 它也指操作机器。

note.en: Handle is compared with look-alike words and words for dealing with things.
note.cn: 把 handle 与形近词以及表示应付事物的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To handle is to take something in hand, whether a problem, a machine, or a cup.
normalIntro.cn: handle 就是把东西拿在手里，无论是问题、机器还是一只杯子。

normal.en: She handled the problem calmly.
He knows how to handle the machine.
normal.cn: 他知道怎样操作这台机器。

normal.en: The handle of the cup is broken.
Wash your hands after handling raw meat.
Handle the box with care.

abstract.en: To handle a thing is to accept its weight.
abstract.cn: 拿起一件东西，就是接受它的重量。

abstract.en: A handle is a promise that the hand belongs there.
abstract.cn: 把手是一种承诺：手该放在这里。

abstract.en: The calm hand steadies the whole room.
abstract.cn: 沉稳的手，稳住整间屋子。

examples.en: She handled the problem calmly.
He knows how to handle the machine.
examples.cn: 他知道怎样操作这台机器。

examples.en: The handle of the cup is broken.

dict_mnemonic.text: handle 是「处理、操作」，也指「触摸」，名词是「把手」；handle a problem 是处理问题，handle with care 是小心轻放，door handle 是门把手。

root: 来自古英语 handlian（用手触摸），源于 hand；用手去碰、去用，引申为操作与处理，又指为手而设的把手。

sensesIntro.en: Handle means to deal with, to operate, a grip part, or to touch with the hands.
sensesIntro.cn: handle 指处理、操作、把手，或用手触摸。

core.en: The hand taking hold of a thing.
core.cn: 手抓住一件东西。

branches.en: A manager calms a difficult meeting.
branches.cn: 管理者稳住一场棘手的会议。

branches.en: A worker turns a control wheel.
branches.cn: 工人转动控制轮。

branches.en: A hand closes on a door grip.
branches.cn: 手握住门把。

branches.en: Fingers touch a rough surface.
branches.cn: 手指触摸粗糙的表面。

branches.en: The grip part and the act of dealing both begin with the hand.
branches.cn: 把手与处理，都从手开始。

intro.en: Handle forms verbs, agent nouns, and compounds of holding.
intro.cn: handle 构成动词、施动者名词，以及表示握持的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word comes from Old English hand.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，源自英语 hand（古英语）。

items.meaning: the bar used to steer a bicycle

definition_en: useful and easy to use, kept near at hand, or good at using your hands
core_image: 工具箱放在伸手可及的地方
scene: 这把小刀很方便携带。This small knife is handy to carry.
sceneCN: 这里 handy 是「便利的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这把小刀很方便携带。

senses.title: Easy to use
senses.definition: useful and easy to use
senses.definitionCN: 有用且容易使用
senses.example: This small knife is handy to carry.
senses.exampleCN: 这把小刀很方便携带。
senses.why: Usefulness with ease is the central sense.
senses.whyCN: 好用又省力，是中心义项。

senses.title: Near at hand
senses.definition: kept near and ready to be used
senses.definitionCN: 放在近处、随时可用
senses.example: Keep the torch handy in case of a power cut.
senses.exampleCN: 把手电放在手边，以防停电。
senses.why: Nearness to the hand is part of being handy.
senses.whyCN: 在手边，是 handy 含义的一部分。

senses.title: Skilled with hands
senses.definition: good at making or repairing things with your hands
senses.definitionCN: 擅长用手制作或修理东西
senses.example: She is handy with tools.
senses.exampleCN: 她使用工具很手巧。
senses.why: A skilled hand also earns this word.
senses.whyCN: 灵巧的手，也配得上这个词。

intro.en: Handy is hand plus the adjective ending -y.
intro.cn: handy 由 hand 加形容词词尾 -y 构成。

items.en: Hand meant the hand.
items.cn: hand 意为手。

items.en: Handy meant done or used by hand.
items.cn: handy 意为用手做的或用手使用的。

items.en: It came to mean easy to use.
items.cn: 它转而表示容易使用。

items.en: It meant kept near at hand.
items.cn: 它表示放在手边。

items.en: It also meant skilled with the hands.
items.cn: 它也指双手灵巧。

note.en: Handy is compared with look-alike words and words for convenience and skill.
note.cn: 把 handy 与形近词以及表示便利与灵巧的词作比较。

entries.definition: the body part at the end of the arm

normalIntro.en: Handy means close to the hand, easy to use, or skilled in the use of hands.
normalIntro.cn: handy 指就在手边、使用方便，或双手灵巧。

normal.en: This small knife is handy to carry.
Keep the torch handy in case of a power cut.
normal.cn: 把手电放在手边，以防停电。

normal.en: She is handy with tools.
A pocket dictionary comes in handy.
The box is handy for storing letters.
normal.cn: 这个盒子用来收纳信件很方便。

abstract.en: What is near the hand is quickly part of the mind.
abstract.cn: 手边的东西，很快成为心智的一部分。

abstract.en: A good tool disappears into its use.
abstract.cn: 好用的工具，会消失在使用之中。

abstract.en: Skilled hands make difficulty look quiet.
abstract.cn: 灵巧的手，让困难显得安静。

examples.en: This small knife is handy to carry.
Keep the torch handy in case of a power cut.
examples.cn: 把手电放在手边，以防停电。

examples.en: She is handy with tools.

dict_mnemonic.text: handy 由 hand 加 -y 构成，意为「便利的、手边的、手巧的」；come in handy 是派得上用场，keep handy 是放在手边。

root: 由 hand（手）加形容词词尾 -y 构成；与手有关，引申为就在手边、用起来方便，以及双手灵巧。

sensesIntro.en: Handy means easy to use, near at hand, or skilled with the hands.
sensesIntro.cn: handy 指便于使用、就在手边，或双手灵巧。

core.en: Within easy reach of the hand.
core.cn: 伸手就能触及。

branches.en: A small tool fits a pocket.
branches.cn: 一件小工具刚好放进衣袋。

branches.en: A torch waits by the door.
branches.cn: 手电放在门边。

branches.en: A repairer turns a screw with ease.
branches.cn: 修理者轻松拧动螺丝。

branches.en: Easy use begins with being near.
branches.cn: 好用的前提，是就在近处。

branches.en: What is near is quickly handled by skilled hands.
branches.cn: 近处的东西，很快被灵巧的手用上。

intro.en: Handy forms comparison, adverbs, nouns, and compounds of skill.
intro.cn: handy 构成比较级、副词、名词，以及表示手艺的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word comes from Old English hand.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，源自英语 hand（古英语）。

items.meaning: a person who does small repairs

definition_en: to take place, to do something by chance, or to find something by chance
core_image: 路口突然响起刹车声
scene: 事故发生在十字路口。The accident happened at the crossing.
sceneCN: 这里 happen 是「发生」（第 1 个义项）；句意：事故发生在十字路口。

senses.title: Take place
senses.definition: to take place, especially without being planned
senses.definitionCN: 发生，尤指未事先计划地发生
senses.example: The accident happened at the crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 事故发生在十字路口。
senses.why: An event taking place is the central sense.
senses.whyCN: 事件发生，是中心义项。

senses.title: By chance
senses.definition: to do something by chance
senses.definitionCN: 碰巧做了某事
senses.example: I happened to meet her at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 我碰巧在车站遇到她。
senses.why: Chance became a word for a lucky coincidence.
senses.whyCN: 偶然，成了表示巧合的说法。

senses.title: Come upon
senses.definition: to find or meet something by chance
senses.definitionCN: 偶然发现或遇到某事
senses.example: He happened on an old letter.
senses.exampleCN: 他偶然发现一封旧信。
senses.why: Finding by chance is the same idea in another form.
senses.whyCN: 偶然发现，是同一概念的另一形式。

intro.en: Happen comes from hap, chance, from Old Norse happ, plus the verb ending -en.
intro.cn: happen 来自古诺斯语 happ（运气、偶然），加动词词尾 -en 构成。

items.en: Happ meant chance or good luck.
items.cn: happ 意为偶然或好运。

items.en: Hap named a chance event.
items.cn: hap 指偶然事件。

items.en: Happen meant to take place by chance.
items.cn: happen 意为偶然发生。

items.en: It extended to any event taking place.
items.cn: 它扩展到任何事件的发生。

items.en: It also meant meeting or finding by chance.
items.cn: 它也指偶然遇到或发现。

note.en: Happen is compared with look-alike words and words for events and chance.
note.cn: 把 happen 与形近词以及表示事件与偶然的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Happen is what chance brings: an event takes place, or two people meet by luck.
normalIntro.cn: happen 是偶然带来的事：事件发生，或两人碰巧相遇。

normal.en: The accident happened at the crossing.
I happened to meet her at the station.
He happened on an old letter.
What happened to your bike?
It will not happen again.

abstract.en: Chance is the part of life no plan can hold.
abstract.cn: 偶然，是任何计划都握不住的那部分生活。

abstract.en: What happens is not always what is chosen.
abstract.cn: 发生的事，不总是被选择的事。

abstract.en: A chance meeting can change a whole road.
abstract.cn: 一次偶遇，能改变整条路。

examples.en: The accident happened at the crossing.
I happened to meet her at the station.
He happened on an old letter.

dict_mnemonic.text: happen 是「发生」，也指「碰巧」和「偶然遇到」；happen to 是碰巧或发生在……身上，what happened 是发生了什么。

root: 来自古诺斯语 happ（运气、偶然），加动词词尾 -en；偶然降临之事，引申为发生、碰巧与偶然遇见。

sensesIntro.en: Happen means to take place, to do something by chance, or to find something by chance.
sensesIntro.cn: happen 指发生、碰巧做某事，或偶然发现某物。

core.en: An event arriving out of chance.
core.cn: 由偶然带来的一件事。

branches.en: A car stops at a crossing.
branches.cn: 一辆车在路口停下。

branches.en: Two friends meet by accident.
branches.cn: 两个朋友偶然相遇。

branches.en: A letter slips from an old book.
branches.cn: 一封信从旧书里滑出。

branches.en: An event and a meeting both arrive by chance.
branches.cn: 事件与相遇，都因偶然到来。

branches.en: Something found and something occurring share the same luck.
branches.cn: 发现与发生，共享同一种运气。

intro.en: Happen forms verb parts, event nouns, and chance compounds.
intro.cn: happen 构成动词变化、事件名词，以及表示偶然的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; hap comes from Old Norse.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，hap 来自古诺斯语。

items.exampleCN: 他们偶然发现一处泉水。

definition_en: a sheltered place where ships can stay, or to shelter something
core_image: 一群小船躲在防波堤后的静水里
scene: 渔船驶回了港口。The fishing boats returned to the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 harbour 是「港口」（第 1 个义项）；句意：渔船驶回了港口。

senses.title: Sheltered port
senses.definition: an area of water sheltered from the sea where ships can stay
senses.definitionCN: 避开外海风浪、可供船只停泊的水域
senses.example: The fishing boats returned to the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 渔船驶回了港口。
senses.why: This is the basic place sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的地点义项。

senses.title: Place of refuge
senses.definition: a place that gives safety from danger or trouble
senses.definitionCN: 使人免受危险或困扰的安全之处
senses.example: The library was a harbour from the noise.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆是躲避喧闹的港湾。
senses.why: A port protects ships, so the word protects people too.
senses.whyCN: 港口护住船只，于是也用来护住人。

senses.title: Shelter someone
senses.definition: to give shelter to a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 给人或动物提供藏身之处
senses.example: They harboured the stray dog.
senses.exampleCN: 他们收留了那只流浪狗。
senses.why: The noun of shelter became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 庇护的名词，转成了动词。

senses.title: Keep a feeling
senses.definition: to keep a thought or feeling secretly in the mind
senses.definitionCN: 在心里暗暗保留某种想法或情感
senses.example: He harboured doubts for years.
senses.exampleCN: 他多年心怀疑虑。
senses.why: The mind can be a harbour for thoughts.
senses.whyCN: 头脑也可以成为想法的港湾。

intro.en: Harbour comes from Old English herebeorg, an army shelter, later any refuge.
intro.cn: harbour 来自古英语 herebeorg（军队的营地），后来泛指避难所。

items.en: The root meant a shelter for an army.
items.cn: 该词根指军队的庇护所。

items.en: Herebeorg meant a lodging or camp.
items.cn: herebeorg 指住处或营地。

items.en: Harbour named a place of safety.
items.cn: harbour 指安全之处。

items.en: It became the usual word for a port.
items.cn: 它成为「港口」的常用词。

items.en: The verb named sheltering and holding ideas.
items.cn: 动词义指收留与心怀想法。

note.en: Harbour is compared with look-alike words and with words for ports and shelter.
note.cn: 把 harbour 与形近词以及表示港口和庇护的词作比较。

entries.definition: a town or place where ships load

normalIntro.en: A harbour holds ships, then holds people, then holds thoughts.
normalIntro.cn: 港口先容下船，再容下人，最后容下念头。

normal.en: The ship entered the harbour at dusk.
This bay is a natural harbour.
The church became a harbour for the homeless.
normal.cn: 教堂成了无家可归者的避难所。

normal.en: They harboured no anger.
She harbours a hope of returning.

abstract.en: Every ship needs a wall against the sea.
abstract.cn: 每条船，都需要一道挡海的墙。

abstract.en: A harbour says nothing and keeps everything.
abstract.cn: 港湾什么也不说，却容下一切。

abstract.en: The heart is the last harbour we build.
abstract.cn: 心，是我们建的最后一个港湾。

examples.en: The fishing boats returned to the harbour.
The library was a harbour from the noise.
examples.cn: 图书馆是躲避喧闹的港湾。

examples.en: He harboured doubts for years.

dict_mnemonic.text: harbour 是「港口」，也指「避难所」；作动词是「庇护、藏匿」，还可表示心里「怀有」想法或怨恨，harbour a grudge 是心怀怨恨。

root: 来自古英语 herebeorg（军队营地），源于日耳曼语；由庇护之所引申为港口与避难所，再引申为心里怀藏某种念头。

sensesIntro.en: Harbour is a sheltered port, a refuge, the act of sheltering, or a feeling kept inside.
sensesIntro.cn: harbour 是避风的港口、避难所、收留的动作，或藏在心里的情感。

core.en: Still water behind a breakwater.
core.cn: 防波堤后的静水。

branches.en: Boats line up behind a stone wall.
branches.cn: 小船排在石墙后。

branches.en: A tired walker finds a dry doorway.
branches.cn: 疲惫的行人找到一个干燥的门洞。

branches.en: A warm kitchen takes in a wet dog.
branches.cn: 温暖的厨房收留了一只湿透的狗。

branches.en: An old man keeps one quiet hope.
branches.cn: 老人守着一个安静的希望。

branches.en: A place and a mind can both give shelter.
branches.cn: 一个地方与一颗心，都能提供庇护。

intro.en: Harbour takes plural and verb endings and forms trade compounds.
intro.cn: harbour 加复数与动词词尾，并构成行业复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.meaning: an official in charge of a port
items.exampleCN: 港务长招手让我们进港。

items.example: The cove is a safe harbour.
